tiGroup.ti: D01 ~ Trigeta i mit long rot

bslGroup.num: Talōw ve-bon̄.
Revrev ve-bon̄.
{ Ve-dese || Tan̄ ni ave? } Ve-bon̄ si vē-ttēs?
bslGroup.olr: Gasva? Ga wē le ga sa?

bslGroup.num: Na, na ve-bon̄, ba nik?
bslGroup.drg: Na va-wē wor, ti nēk va-sav?
bslGroup.olr: Na ga wē sasa, le nēk gasva?
bslGroup.lkn: Na ga wē siisa, to inēk? Ga wē le… (ga sa)?

bslGroup.mtp: Ino se, ino itōk a itōk.
bslGroup.num: Na mēlē, na ve-bon̄ wos.
bslGroup.olr: Na mula, na ga wē sasa.
bslGroup.lkn: Na lēh, na ga wē siisa.

bslGroup.num: Nik ve-mōrōs te van ve?
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk ga marēs ga van have?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi wantem go longwe long sanbij.
bslGroup.num: Na ve-mōrōs te van ror e { a le won || a le naw }.
bslGroup.drg: Na va-mrōs van swēl a le on.
bslGroup.kro: Na v-mōrōs van sēwēl a la.
bslGroup.olr: Na ga mērēs van sas roy le non.
bslGroup.lkn: Na ga marēs van sēwēl rōkōw le 'en.
bslGroup.mrl: No n-mërōs van {sulēw || row} le ën.

bslGroup.num: Nik te dese?

bslGroup.mtp: Nok so van { yapyap mōmō || ba-yapyap }.
bslGroup.num: Na ve-mōrōs te van be reverev wēg.
bslGroup.kro: Na v-mōrōs van selsäl o mäs.
bslGroup.olr: Na ga mērēs van sal mēs.

bslGroup.mtp: Nok so van { kaykay mōmō || ba-kaykay }.
bslGroup.num: Na ve-mōrōs te van be venven wēg.
bslGroup.drg: Na va-mrōs { s-vēn || so-srig } o mās.
bslGroup.kro: Na v-mōrōs van tōw o mäs.
bslGroup.olr: Na ga mērēs van waa mēs.

bslGroup.num: Na ve-mōrōs te van be sivtē net.
bslGroup.drg: Na va-mrōs van { rev || qavtē } o sar.
bslGroup.kro: Na v-mōrōs van rev o sar.
bslGroup.olr: Na ga mērēs { vivis || qaa } say.

bslGroup.bsl: Be yutufala, yu2f. i stap go wea?
bslGroup.num: Wat kumur ten tive?
bslGroup.drg: La ikmur, ikmur t-van i ve ti?
bslGroup.kro: La kumur, kumur t-van ti ve?
bslGroup.olr: La kumuy, kumuy tē van ti ve?
bslGroup.lkn: To gamuu tē van to have?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi2f. i stap go longwe, long karen
bslGroup.num: Kamar te van ti sa e a le wetan.
bslGroup.drg: Kmār t-van kal sag (nen̄) t' a le-m̄sa.
bslGroup.kro: Kämär t-van ti saa ne le m̄as.
bslGroup.olr: Kēmēy tē van kal ti saa le tuqē.
bslGroup.lkn: Gamaa tē van ajew to rokag lē m̄ēhm̄ēh.

bslGroup.bsl: Be karen blong yu2f. i stap wea?
bslGroup.num: Wat wetan nammur ve sa ave?
bslGroup.kro: La namumur o m̄as m-sag kēl ve?
bslGroup.olr: Mo-muy tuqē tē { saa || on } ti ve?
bslGroup.lkn: To m̄ēhm̄ēh moomuu tē hag to have?

bslGroup.bsl: Karen bl. mi2f. i stap klosap nomo, long plesia longwe.
bslGroup.mtp: Nē-tqē nonmamyō isqet ēwē hay agōh.
bslGroup.num: Wetan nammar rivte am, sa in.
bslGroup.drg: Namikmār o m̄sa vrigtēg wor, sag gēn.
bslGroup.kro: Namomär o m̄as m-sag virita wor, sag ēn.
bslGroup.olr: Mo-mēy tuqē rivtaa woy, saa ne.
bslGroup.lkn: Moomaa m̄ēhm̄ēh nen̄ rigtäg woo, roka 'i.

bslGroup.bsl: Folem rot lelbit i go antap, kasem top blong hil,
bslGroup.mtp: Nēk dam tusu ēwē na-mtehal hay en, tō dēn̄ l-ulsi wutwut,
bslGroup.num: Nik van kal usur gorsal, nik ti-din̄ lus taqin̄in,
bslGroup.drg: Van srēg galāg sag srēg o sal, ti sag nen̄ a mke tōw,
bslGroup.kro: Van tetäg o matsal sag, kal sag meke tōw,
bslGroup.olr: Van kal saa le mataale, van jēn̄ meke tōw,
bslGroup.lkn: Van suusuu mataalē gäläg hag, van jēn̄ { make || hag on qähä } taōw,
bslGroup.mrl: Van gusur metsal kal seag, kal seag mak vutvut,

bslGroup.mtp: tō nēk hēw tēqēl lok se tekelgi.
bslGroup.num: nik tov van tēqēl kēl tavōlōn.
bslGroup.lkn: { we hēw sēwēl lōk talvōn (taōw) || lak van kēl on talvōn }.

bslGroup.num: kēl van e.
kēl van e.

bslGroup.mtp: Auu! { Yeh meh || Yeh a yeh }!
bslGroup.num: Auu! Aras wos!

bslGroup.mtp: Óòǒ, tateh, et-yeh te! Isqet ēwē!
bslGroup.num: Bek, veta aras mi! Rivte am.
bslGroup.olr: Taga, te ras wōs, rivtaa woy!
bslGroup.lkn: Taa, tē rah awōh! Rigtäg woo!

bslGroup.mtp: Nēk so van { tatag || dam } me kamyō?
bslGroup.num: Nik ve-mōrōs te van ma usur kamar?
bslGroup.olr: Nēk ga mērēs van tusuy kēmēy?
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk ga marēs van suusuu gamaa?
bslGroup.mrl: Neak mërōs ven mē gusur kamar?

bslGroup.num: O, na ve-mōrōs, wat tuqa.
bslGroup.olr: O, na ga mērēs, la taga mele.
bslGroup.lkn: E, na a marēs, la ta male.
bslGroup.mrl: Në n-mërōs, si {tuqa tu || tuqe tea}.

bslGroup.num: Sur saven?

bslGroup.bsl: From mifela i nogat kakae bl. mif. long haos bl. mifela
bslGroup.mtp: Veg kemem, na-ganmem gengen mē-qēt l-ēm̄ nononmem…
bslGroup.num: Sur kama, nagama gengen bek a le guvur (namma),
bslGroup.drg: Sur ikma ngakma o gāngēn obek a lē gvur (namikma),
bslGroup.kro: Sur nagama o gengän bek l-guvur namoma,
bslGroup.olr: Suy kama gēngēn gaiv le mo-ma guvuy,
bslGroup.lkn: On gamä gängän gaiv l-um̄ä moomä,
bslGroup.mrl: Sur kemem, tagat gengen le ean̄(mem),

bslGroup.mtp: … nok so van von̄opn̄on bah en.
bslGroup.num: … na te van titi be-reverev.
Magōrōs!
Bek, ve-bon̄ am.

bslGroup.bsl: …yumi3 bae i luk yumi3 bakegen tedei long aftenun
bslGroup.mtp: Ēntēl qoyo et lok se dētēl qiyig le-myēpyep,
bslGroup.num: Dōtōl qar kērkēr kēl dōtōl aqiri a le revrev,
bslGroup.drg: Tōlgēn s-tek kēl tōlgēn aqri le rāvrēv,
bslGroup.kro: Tēlēn vē-ēlēl kēl tēlēn qiri l-revräv,
bslGroup.olr: Jēlēt ga ēl kēl jēlēt qirii le ravrav.
bslGroup.lkn: Tēlēj lak 'ät'ätä lōk tēlēj qirig on rävräv,

bslGroup.bsl: …from i gat wan lafet long vilej
bslGroup.num: sur lavēt tutwal a le vunu.
bslGroup.drg: sur tuar tālwōn̄ le (namigēn) o vre {sa || nen̄}.
bslGroup.kro: sur tuar o gengän v-luwo l-vōnō.
bslGroup.olr: suy tay soysoy ga rēē le moj vōnō.
bslGroup.lkn: on too gängän ēhē le vanō.

bslGroup.num: Vidun? Gin te laklak?
Aa, gin te laklak.
Au, ve-bon̄ wos ran!
Na ve-mōrōs te laklak mēlē.
bslGroup.drg: Na mlē va-mrōs laklak namuk sa!
bslGroup.lkn: Na lēh, na marēs a lak itä!

bslGroup.bsl: Spos yu kam joenem mifela, bae yu jes tanis tu!
bslGroup.mtp: Nēk wo ma-van me biyin̄ kemem, nēk tiqyo laklak te mu.
bslGroup.num: Si nik te van ma usur kama, nik qar laklak.
bslGroup.drg: Kak nēk m-van srēg kma ma, nēk qra laklak {namon̄ || mlē}!
bslGroup.kro: Nēk v-mōrōs ak v-lak mi kama, v-wē wor, nēk qara laklak na-mon̄.
bslGroup.olr: Nēk ōl mērēs van tusuy kama, nēk tak lak { mogon̄ || tatga }.
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk ga marēs a pirin̄ gamä, nēk lak lak itä.
bslGroup.mrl: Si neak mi mërōs ven mē sur kemem, neak qer laklak.

bslGroup.num: Alē, qōn̄ ve-bon̄.
Alē, sasa ve-bon̄ / Vanvan ve-bon̄.
bslGroup.kro: O van ti i! / O sag ti!
bslGroup.olr: Nēk o saa! Kēmēy tē van nok ti.
bslGroup.lkn: Yō, nēk tē hag, gamuu tē van!

bslGroup.num: Kanol Ros (21) + Harol Simion (41)

tiGroup.ti: D02 ~ Mi no slip gut long naet

rfGroup.num: Na veta n̄or lin̄lin̄i (mi) a le qōn̄.
rfGroup.drg: Na t-n̄or tavul tēmē lē qōn̄.
rfGroup.lkn: Na tē n̄oo kere awōh on qēn̄.

bslGroup.num: Nik te tavraket!

bslGroup.bsl: San i kam antap longtaem finis!
bslGroup.num: Walo ve an kal ata ma!
bslGroup.drg: O lo m-kal nok ma attua!
bslGroup.lkn: Alo ēn van ajew atiä nok!

bslGroup.bsl: Be yu stap slip let olsemia from wanem?
bslGroup.mtp: Nēk me-mtiy taq qele nen ba-hap?
bslGroup.num: Nik te n̄orn̄or taq tan̄ nen sur saven?
bslGroup.drg: Nēk t-n̄or taq ti tm̄e nen̄ ti sur sa?
bslGroup.lkn: To nēk tē n̄oo ul to m̄ērē nen̄ on naha?
bslGroup.mrl: Neak mëtur taq n̄werē sur sa?

bslGroup.bsl: Yu no slip gut long naet?
bslGroup.num: Nik veta n̄orn̄or lin̄lin̄i (mi) a le qōn̄?
bslGroup.drg: Nēk {t-n̄or || s-n̄or} tavul tēmē lē qōn̄?
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk tē n̄oo kere avōh on qēn̄?
bslGroup.mrl: Neak ti mëtur mēnmēn tea lö qōn̄?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi harem faol i singsing finis,
bslGroup.num: Na ve ron̄ote to ve tottorak (v)ata,
bslGroup.drg: Na m-ron̄ o to m-totrak nok,
bslGroup.lkn: Na 'n ron̄ to ēn jajak nok,

bslGroup.bsl: be bodi blong mi i les tumas, i no save kirap.
bslGroup.mtp: ba veg na-taybēk me-myen̄, nok hatig lēlēgē.
bslGroup.num: wat nabek ve mururur wos vaenti, manta tavraket le.
bslGroup.drg: la na bēk s-wē tēmē, na vte togvut late.
bslGroup.lkn: la epek tē roj siisa to, na turag ēs avōh.
bslGroup.mrl: nu-turi-k ti wea tea, no bit taprak le tea.

bslGroup.num: E! Sur saven?

bslGroup.bsl: Long naet mi wantem slip, be nogat, mi no save kasem.
bslGroup.mtp: An̄qōn̄ en nok so mitiy, ba tateh, nok mitimtiy lēlēgē.
bslGroup.num: A le qōn̄, na ve mōrōs te n̄or, wat na manta n̄or le.
bslGroup.drg: Lē qōn̄ na va-mrōs n̄or, la bek, na vte n̄or tavul late.
bslGroup.lkn: On qēn̄ na ga ma(r)ēs (g)a n̄oo, la ta vata na tē n̄oo ēs avōh.
bslGroup.mrl: Lö qōn̄ no n-mërōs n̄orn̄or, nen tēgē, no bit n̄or le tea.

bslGroup.num: Saven ve takili nik?

bslGroup.bsl: Be from, bebe bl. mi2f. i stap krae oltaem
bslGroup.mtp: Ba veg, tētē nonmamyō ni-ten̄ten̄ qētēl.
bslGroup.num: Bek, sur nutmar te rarra ti valqōn̄.
bslGroup.drg: Sur i ntikmār m-tān̄ mrān ti.
bslGroup.lkn: On natōmaa tē rara gaagaahē to.
bslGroup.mrl: Sur netmarō { sa-n̄arn̄ar lō-qōn̄ || nu-n̄ar nemeren }.

bslGroup.num: Vidun? Ni te sen̄sen̄?
Bek, kosen ve bas ata!

bslGroup.bsl: Bifo, hem i bin sik l. fiva, l. las manis
bslGroup.mtp: Am̄ag, kē mo-gom tō bo-momyiy, lō-wōl mey a mal bah
bslGroup.num: Taqa, ni me sen̄sen̄ qatma(g)ev vata ti, a le tuar wisn̄ar.
bslGroup.drg: Am̄o, ni m-sem̄ gin o msag, lē tuar sn̄ar.
bslGroup.lkn: Nahnē, weswes ēn ran̄ nē, le vōl ēn pah nok.
bslGroup.mrl: Neweas n̄ē, tuar vōl, nu-sean̄ nen ne-mmerir.

bslGroup.bsl: be mi3f. i go tekem hem long dokta,
bslGroup.mtp: ba kamtēl ma-van tēy kē hiy dokta,
bslGroup.num: wat kamatōl me sol ni a le guvur marisin;
bslGroup.drg: tōlkma m-sol ni min o tresa.
bslGroup.lkn: la tēlēmä 'n lä nē mun dokta,
bslGroup.mrl: Kemem bul töl nu-van sur tokta,

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i givim meresin blong bebe
bslGroup.num: Teresa me le marisin nama m̄am̄m̄ari,
bslGroup.drg: Ni m-la o mērsin min o m̄ērm̄ēr,

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i drink, ale i no longtaem hem i kam gut.
bslGroup.mtp: kē ni-in, tō et-misin te kē ni-wē lok.
bslGroup.num: Ni mi sim, veta-tta mi ma ni tov ōs.
bslGroup.drg: Ni m-sim, to mumul tēmē ni so ēs kēl.
bslGroup.lkn: Nē 'n un woo, tē maul avōh nē tē wē lōk.
bslGroup.mrl: Sean mi-sim, ti mul tea sen ti wea.

bslGroup.bsl: Be long naet ia, hem i stap krae i defren lelbit.
bslGroup.mtp: Ba an̄qōn̄ kē, kē ni-ten̄ten̄ en suvay-tegha.
bslGroup.num: Wat ale qōn̄ en, ni te-rra ti, sēsē gele.
bslGroup.drg: La lē qōn̄ sa, ni t-tān̄ ti gēsgēs.
bslGroup.lkn: La on qēn̄ nen̄, nē tē rara to ga vageh gäläg.
bslGroup.mrl: Nen lō-qōn̄ kē, sean ma-n̄ar tuar-sean.

bslGroup.bsl: Ating hem i fraet long ol devil?
bslGroup.num: Ni wun ve qane tare tamat?
bslGroup.drg: Wudek ni wedek t-matwut o tmat ti?
bslGroup.lkn: Nē wujek tē matwus tan̄ro to?

bslGroup.num: naqutun wun ve ma(g)ev? si nataqan?
bslGroup.drg: na qtōn t-māwis ti, le na tqan?
bslGroup.lkn: le qatōn / toqan tē miiren̄ to?

bslGroup.bsl: o hangre i mekem hem, o wanem?
bslGroup.mtp: si so na-maygay wun m-ak kē, si m-akteg?
bslGroup.num: Milin̄sal wun ve takili ni, si saven?
bslGroup.drg: Le ni va-mdō, le kak o sa?
bslGroup.lkn: Le sieg tē wes nē to, le naha?

bslGroup.bsl: Mebi hem i wantem trink kokonas?
bslGroup.num: Ni wun ve mōrōs (te) simsim mutu?
bslGroup.drg: Wudek ni va-mrōs sim o mtō?
bslGroup.lkn: Ni wujek ga marēs ga un matu?

bslGroup.bsl: Nogat: mama bl'm i traem mekem hem i kakae (wan mango), be hem i no laekem.
bslGroup.mtp: Tateh! Tita nonon ne-myōs galeg so kē so ni-gengen, ba kē et-buste.
bslGroup.num: Bek! Ra-vven ve mōrōs si ni te gengen, wat ni veta mōrōs.
bslGroup.drg: Obek! I vven m-la o gāngēn min ni, ni so-mrōs tēmē.
bslGroup.lkn: Ta! Veven ēn mäkä ätägäh sa ni ga gängän, la ni tē marēs avōh.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē! Ivven nu-lē { mi nea || m-nea }} ne-gengen, sean nu-taraw.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale hem i wantem mekem i titi, be hem i no laekem
bslGroup.mtp: Kē ne-myōs so kē so ni-sis, ba kē et-buste.
bslGroup.num: Ni ve mōrōs te le min ni wusus, wat ni veta mōrōs.
bslGroup.drg: Ni va-mrōs kak i ntōn susus, ni so-mrōs tēmē.
bslGroup.lkn: Nē a maēs a lä huh mun nē, la nē tē marēs avōh.
bslGroup.mrl: Sean nu-lē mi-nea nu-sus, sen nu-taraw.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi2f. i traem kwaetem hem, be nating [lêlêge]
bslGroup.mtp: Kamyō so ak togyon̄ kē, ba akak lēlēge.
bslGroup.num: Kamar ve mōrōs ta be ni te sa nodo, wat bek ran.
bslGroup.drg: Kmār va-mrōs s-la sagron̄ ni, obek.
bslGroup.lkn: Gamaa 'n qis roron̄ tägäh nē, la taa vata.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi no save se bae mi mekwanem i gut,
bslGroup.mtp: Nok et-ēglal te so nok so akteg itōk,
bslGroup.num: Na veta gil mi si na te takili saven ve bon̄,
bslGroup.drg: Na so-vrēgēl tēmē na s-damag o sav va-wē,
bslGroup.lkn: Na ga ron̄ avōh sa na ga { vaha ga wē mun nē || mäkä naha ga wē },
bslGroup.mrl: No ti valgear tea no sa-da gesva (si) ti wea,

bslGroup.bsl: ale paliga (bl. mi) hem i harem voes bl. pikinini,
bslGroup.mtp: tō, qēlgek lōqōvēn mo-yon̄teg na-ln̄an nētm̄ey en,
bslGroup.num: bas qalgak tawa ve ron̄ote naln̄a m̄am̄m̄ari,
bslGroup.drg: ti qelgak o rqa ni m-ron̄ na ln̄a m̄erm̄er
bslGroup.lkn: to qelgak gamtō ni 'n ron̄ eln̄an miini,
bslGroup.mrl: qelgok na-vavean ti rron̄ nē-lēn̄e lōn̄wēr,

bslGroup.bsl: hem i tingting tumas long hem
bslGroup.num: ni ve dōdōm wos sur.
bslGroup.drg: ni { so dōm || m°ō°-dōm } { adan || mawmawis } sur.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i kirap hem i kam insaed hem i karem [bem / bo / oyveg] bubu bl'm i aot
bslGroup.mtp: Kē ni-hatig hag nen, kē ni-hayveg me tō kē ni-bem yak bōbō nonon tō kōyō kalō yow.
bslGroup.num: Ni me tavraket ni me kal ma ni me toko tubun ru tov van avere.
bslGroup.drg: Ni m-togvut ni m-kal ma o gvur ni m-gorvāg i tbōn rār so kal i vre.
bslGroup.lkn: Ni 'n turag, ni tē ol ma ni tē sapläg tōpōn ni tē ol matum̄ä.
bslGroup.mrl: Ti taprak, ti kal ser-mē ti lē tōbōn ti { bēbē || bea } kal row verē.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale hem i singsing wan singsing long hem, wan singsing blong pikinini
bslGroup.mtp: Tō kē ni-se n-eh vitwag van hiy kē, n-eh wehewheg ige susu.
bslGroup.num: Bas ni tov raw tuar wes, wes ve gal ra mel m̄am̄m̄ari.
bslGroup.drg: Ni so twa tuar o ās min ni, o ās n̄orn̄or.
bslGroup.lkn: Ni tē 'äh too 'äh mun nē, too 'äh avan n̄oon̄oo.
bslGroup.mrl: Ti rewrew nē-es mi-nea, nē-es tabe aw lōn̄wēr.

bslGroup.bsl: Afta, bubu man bl'm i kam tu,
bslGroup.mtp: Tō, bōbō tam̄an nonon ni-hayveg se me,
bslGroup.num: Bas, { pupu m̄erat namun || tubun m̄erat } ni me an mēlē ma,
bslGroup.drg: Bas, i tbōn o m̄erat so van ma,
bslGroup.lkn: Va# van, tōpōn m̄eerat tē row lēh ma,
bslGroup.mrl: Bas lan, i tōbōn na-n̄warat ti ven mē,

bslGroup.bsl: hem i talem wan storian bl. bifo
bslGroup.mtp: kē ni-vap na-vap t-am̄ag vitwag hiy kē.
bslGroup.num: ni me kekkeom t-am̄o.
bslGroup.lkn: ni tē suu too suusuu pule maraw avan m̄o.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale bebe i jas finis krae, hem i laf, mo hem i slip bakegen
bslGroup.mtp: Tō tētē qoyo bah ne-ten̄ten̄, kē ni-yēyē, tō kē ni-mtiy lok se.
bslGroup.num: Bas, m̄am̄m̄ari to-qar bas rarra, ni me vatn̄el, bas ni tov n̄or kēl.
bslGroup.drg: Bas m̄erm̄er nen̄ so bas tān̄tēn̄, ni so bor, ni so n̄or kēl.
bslGroup.lkn: Va# van, miini lak pah rarara, ni tē 'uu, ni tē n̄oo lōk lēh.
bslGroup.mrl: Tu nō-lōn̄wēr ti bas n̄arn̄ar, ti manman, ti mëtur kēl.

bslGroup.bsl: Finis, ale mifela evriwan i go slip nao, slip kasem delaet.
bslGroup.mtp: Bah, tō kemem del van mitiy ēgēn, mitiy dēn̄ a le-myen.
bslGroup.num: Bas, kamam bas ran tov van n̄or din̄ maren.
bslGroup.drg: Bas, kma dōl so van n̄or, m-n̄or dēn̄ o mrān.
bslGroup.lkn: Pah, gamä vata pah tē van n̄oo lōk lēh, n̄oo jēn̄ maarän.
bslGroup.mrl: Ti bas, kemem döl ga van mëtur, dean̄ lō-tōlō.

bslGroup.num: Antonet Rovanle (18)

bslGroup.bsl: E, brata! Mi no save yu yet, nem bl. yu huia?
bslGroup.num: (… Na-ssin̄ sē?)
bslGroup.kro: Tsik! Na t-ron̄ wōs mele nēk, na-ssan̄ isē?
bslGroup.olr: Ey, {tuak || tisik}! Na tē ron̄ vēlēē wōs mele ti nēk, sasan̄ isē?
bslGroup.lkn: E, tuak! Na ga ron̄ vēgēl avōh male nēk, hahan̄ isē?
bslGroup.mrl: E, tuok! No ti valgear tea miak. { Na-sasan̄ || Na-ssan̄ } isē?

bslGroup.num: (Na? Na-ssik Tagar)

bslGroup.bsl: Be yu? Mi no save nem bl.yu tu.
bslGroup.kro: Ti nēk? Na t-ron̄ tavul wōs mē na-ssan̄.
bslGroup.olr: La inēk? Na tē ron̄ mele wōs sasan̄.
bslGroup.lkn: La inēk? Na ga ron̄ vēgēl lēh avōh hahan̄.
bslGroup.mrl: Nen ineak? Ti valgear tea na-ssan̄ mila.

bslGroup.kro: Nēr t-var na ti kak i Torba.
bslGroup.olr: Nēy tē vit na ti ka Torba.
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē tē vis na to sa Torba.

bslGroup.bsl: Ating? Be "Torba" ia, i no wan nem blong man, i wan nem blong ples!
bslGroup.kro: Ties o Torba nen̄, ni se tudun wōs mē, ni o se tuar vōnō.
bslGroup.olr: Vutwē? La “Torba” nan̄, tē sasa jujun̄ wōs, sasa vōnō woy!
bslGroup.lkn: Wuswē? La Torba nen̄, haha jaajun avōh, haha vanō woo!
bslGroup.mrl: Surwea? Ne Torba, ti sēsē tedun tea, nē-sē verē.

bslGroup.bsl: Be from, olgeta famle blong mi ol i blong wanwan aelan blong Torba.
bslGroup.kro: Sur o si tudun na-muk nēr °vētun° vōnō tutuwal le Torba.
bslGroup.olr: Suy nēy wō si jujun̄ muk, nēy men val-vōnō men Torba.
bslGroup.lkn: On gēē wēē hihi jaajun mok gēē avan lē vanō tuwtuwa lē Torba.
bslGroup.mrl: Sur re tutuok ker lē tuar verē Torba.

bslGroup.bsl: Papa bl. mi hem i man blong Motalava,
hem i bon longwe long smol aelan Ra ia.
bslGroup.kro: ni m-wot vak-ēn, netgi vōnō a Ra.
bslGroup.olr: ni m-wata ēn vak, lē vōnō ga varii Ra.
bslGroup.lkn: nē 'n wotä päh gēn, lē vanō ga sik Ra.

bslGroup.bsl: Be taem hem i pikinini, hem i bin stap longwe long Gaua
bslGroup.kro: M̄ar ni otik, ni m-sag a Gō.
bslGroup.olr: Ni n-putē, ni m-saasaa tavten ne Gaō / Lakon.
bslGroup.lkn: On wēhn̄i nē ga sik / nē 'n miini, nē 'n haghag vaan heg Gaō / Lakon.
bslGroup.mrl: Le mësë sean nō-lōn̄wēr, sean mo-tog ka sōw Lakon.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i stap wetem wan bubu bl'm,
bslGroup.lkn: Nē tē hag mēn too tōpōn to,

bslGroup.bsl: Stap googo, hem i wan man finis,
bslGroup.kro: Sag vavan, ni nok o tudun;
bslGroup.olr: Ni m-saa vavavan, ni tay jujun̄ nok,
bslGroup.lkn: Hag va# van, ni 'n too jaajun nok,

bslGroup.bsl: ale hem i go lukaotem wok longwe long Santo.
bslGroup.kro: ti ni van äm na-mon mugmugu Santo.
bslGroup.olr: ni m-van ēm mon muumugu { roy || saa } nan̄ Sajo.
bslGroup.lkn: nē lak van äm mon mugmugu { hōw || hag } nen̄ Sajo.
bslGroup.mrl: sean ti van ti eal mun wok ki van Santo.

bslGroup.bsl: Mama blong mi hem blong Vanualava, longwe long Vatrata, narasaed blong hil.
bslGroup.kro: Ivēk vet Vōnōlav, nē vet Vatrata, tavlōn tōw.
bslGroup.olr: Vivēk men Vōnōlav, vak nan̄ Vetrat, talvōn tōw.
bslGroup.lkn: Vevek avan Vanōlav, päh nen̄ Vetrat, talvōn { taōw || takm̄ē }.
bslGroup.mrl: Ivep n-at ta Vōnōlap, ka sōw Vetrata, taval vutvut.

bslGroup.bsl: Tedei yet, hem i gat wan karen blong hem i stap long saed blong volkenu.
bslGroup.kro: Qiri mala, na-non tuar o m̄as ni t-sa bet lēwē gerät ti.
bslGroup.olr: Qirii mele ti, mon m̄ēsm̄ēs iē rivtaa suy nōy.
bslGroup.lkn: Jēn̄ qirig heg, mon too m̄ēhm̄ēh male ēhē on liwi ahōō.
bslGroup.mrl: Qerig kē, nō-bōlan oōn̄ so-tog bebeag { folkenu || eplap }.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale, hem i stap googo, taem hem i wan gel finis,
bslGroup.kro: Ni m-sa vavan, ni o m̄alm̄al nok,
bslGroup.olr: Ni m-saa vanvan, jēn ni n-m̄alm̄al vēlēē,
bslGroup.lkn: Nē 'n hag va# van, jēn̄ nē 'n too m̄alm̄al kere,

bslGroup.bsl: hem i go skul longwe long Santo.
bslGroup.kro: ni m-van sur o manar Santo.
bslGroup.lkn: nē tē van sukul { hōw || hag } nen̄ Sajo.
bslGroup.mrl: ti van bu-skul ki van Santo.

bslGroup.bsl: papa bl.yu wetem mama bl.yu tugeta i mit longwe?
bslGroup.kro: Taman̄ tän iven̄ ru vē-ēlēl vak nen̄?
bslGroup.olr: Taman̄ viven̄ mō vējēn̄ { vak || saa || roy } jēk?
bslGroup.lkn: Taman̄ mēn veven̄ wōrō 'n vajvajēn̄ { päh || hōw || hag } nen̄?
bslGroup.mrl: Taman̄ ten ivvean̄ kararō nu-serqak { ka row || ki van }?

bslGroup.bsl: Yes. Stap smol long Santo, tugeta i kambak l. Torba bakegen
bslGroup.kro: Vwē. Ni m-sa gäläg Santo, ru bas ru v-mōl kēl ma Torba.
bslGroup.olr: Ni ēn nan̄! Nōrō mō saa galaa Sajo, nōrō pas van lok ma Torba.
bslGroup.lkn: Nē gēn nen̄ le! Wōrō 'n hag gäläg woo Sajo, wōrō tē mulä lōk ma Torba.
bslGroup.mrl: Surwea. Kararō nu-tog le mësë veti Santo, kararō mē-kēl mē lo Torba.

bslGroup.bsl: Afta, tugeta i stap wok long Torres.
bslGroup.olr: Pas, nōrō tē wok ti Tores.
bslGroup.lkn: Pah, wōrō tē qētēg mugmugu Tores.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol i tijim ol pikinini long skul.
bslGroup.olr: Nōrō tē vatna putputē ti lē sukul.
bslGroup.lkn: Wōrō tē vatog miimiini to lē sukul.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale, long taem ia, tugeta i bonem mi wetem sista blong mi.
bslGroup.kro: Bas, l-wasn̄i nen̄, ru m-vusus na ti tätäk.
bslGroup.olr: Lē wasn̄i ne, nōrō vusus na mēn tatik.
bslGroup.lkn: Lē wēhn̄i nen̄, wōrō tē vahuh na mēn tatak.
bslGroup.mrl: Le mësë kē, kararō vawot kamarō tok tuok.

bslGroup.bsl: Mekem se yu bon long Torres?
bslGroup.kro: Daw ti nēk m-wot a Tores?
bslGroup.olr: Mō jaw ka nēk mō wata Tores?
bslGroup.lkn: Mäkä sa nēk ēn wotä Tores?
bslGroup.mrl: Da kan si neak mo-wot Torēs?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi gat graon blong mi longwe long Hiw.
bslGroup.kro: Na-muk o lem iē a Hiw.
bslGroup.lkn: Mok tanē ēhē { hōw || rōkōw } nen̄ Hiw.

bslGroup.bsl: I gut, be yu forgetem aelan bl. Ureparapara ia.
bslGroup.kro: V-wē, la na lon̄ m-sil vōnō Parpara.
bslGroup.olr: Ga wē, la lolon̄ mō sil vōnō Ōlpaypay.
bslGroup.lkn: Ga wē, la lolon̄ ēn hil vanō Ōlpaapaa.

bslGroup.bsl: Nogat! Waef bl. mi hem i blong longwe ia, blong Divers Bay
bslGroup.kro: Bek! Na-muk o raqa ni vet a Divers Bay.
bslGroup.olr: Taga! Muk raqa men vak nan̄, men Divers Bay.
bslGroup.lkn: Ta! Mok gamtō avan vaan inen̄, avan Divers Bay.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē! Ronëtuk nat taē, nat ta (Lēyēp).

bslGroup.bsl: Be stret aelan blong hem, Roua;
bslGroup.kro: La na-mon o vōnō wē a Roua.
bslGroup.olr: La { tenene mon vōnō || tirii vōnō mon }, Rivaelan.
bslGroup.lkn: La mon tirig vanō, { Riv-aelan || vanō mä'äs }.

bslGroup.bsl: from longtaem bifo, i gat wan bigfela hariken longwe long Roua,
bslGroup.kro: Sur m̄o räs wē, o qatgi län̄vus a Roua.
bslGroup.olr: Suy m̄o ma vak jēk, tay qatgi lēn̄vus ga rēē roy jēk Riv-aelan,
bslGroup.lkn: On maa m̄o, too qatug län̄vuh ēn vuh Rivaelan,
bslGroup.mrl: Sur an̄wo, ne-len̄vus lap ma-dawe Arō,

bslGroup.bsl: mo ol bubu blong hem ol i tekem kenu,
bslGroup.olr: Nēy wō tōptōpōn mō la nak,
bslGroup.lkn: to wēēwēē tōptōpōn gēē 'n lä 'n ak,

bslGroup.olr: nēy mō to jēn̄ ti Ōlpaypay.
bslGroup.lkn: gēē tē to' { jēn̄ to || to jēn̄ } Ōlpaapaa.

bslGroup.bsl: Yes, mi harem finis storian blong hem.
bslGroup.kro: E, na m-ron̄ nok susräg ta iē.
bslGroup.olr: Na m-ron̄ nok ususraa men iē.
bslGroup.lkn: E, na 'n ron̄ nok suusuu avan ēhē.
bslGroup.mrl: Surwea, no nu-rron̄ vita nu-luwluw tebēn.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale, fesbon bl. mi, hem i maretem wan woman Mota
bslGroup.kro: Bas, na-muk o mētē, ni m-läg mē raqa vet M̄ota;
bslGroup.olr: Alē, nutuk wata-sēngarak, ni m-laa mēn tay raqa men M̄ot.
bslGroup.lkn: To mok sēngarak nē { 'n lä || 'n läg mēn } too gamtō avan M̄ot.
bslGroup.mrl: Ale nëtuk nutugē lōn̄wēr, sean mē-lē na-vavean ta N̄wot.

bslGroup.bsl: mo sekonbon, wan gel, long nekis yia bambae hem i maretem wan man Merelava
bslGroup.kro: Wot malawor-mēkēn, o raqa, tuar taw ni v-läg mē tuar tōdun ta M̄erlav.
bslGroup.olr: ti wata-jērēs, tay m̄alm̄al, lē tay tu ni ga laa mēn tay m̄arat men M̄eylav.
bslGroup.lkn: to natuk vagrō mē, too m̄alm̄al, lē too jam, nē ga läg mēn too m̄eerat avan M̄eelav.
bslGroup.mrl: Netes lōn̄wēr, nō-lōn̄wēr vavean, tuar tō sean se-leag bë-tedun ta N̄worlap.

bslGroup.bsl: Olsemia yu wan tru man blong Torba!
bslGroup.kro: M̄ar nen̄ nēk o tudun vutvutwē vet Torba.
bslGroup.olr: M̄ay nan̄ nēk { tirii || vutwē } jujun̄ men Torba.
bslGroup.lkn: M̄ērē nen̄ nēk ēn too tirig jaajun avan Torba.
bslGroup.mrl: Warn̄ea kan neak nu-tur tedun surwea ta Torba!

bslGroup.bsl: Be hem nao, mi talem finis!
bslGroup.olr: Ni ēn nan̄, na m-vit nok!
bslGroup.lkn: To nē gēn nen̄, na 'n vis nok!

bslGroup.bsl: From samting ia nao ol i kolem mi se "Torba"!
bslGroup.kro: Sur o va nen̄ nēr t-var na ti kak Torba.
bslGroup.olr: Suy nova ēn nan̄ nēy tē vay na ti ka Torba.
bslGroup.lkn: On nanvä nen̄ le gēē tē vää na to sa Torba!

bslGroup.bsl: Be i gut, bae mi kolem yu olsemia nao!
bslGroup.kro: La v-wē, na v-var nēk m̄ar °nē° nen̄ le!
bslGroup.olr: Ti ga wē, na ga { vit || vay } nēk m̄ay nan̄.
bslGroup.lkn: To ga wē, na ga vää nēk m̄ērē nen̄ le!

bslGroup.drg: Na m-van tatar le gvur tatar.
bslGroup.lkn: Na 'n van tataa lē um̄ä tataa.

bslGroup.mrl: Nen ineak ven mē nen avea?
bslGroup.drg: Ba nēk, nēk m-van a ve?
bslGroup.lkn: To nēk, nēk in van ma have?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi, mi bin swim long wora.
Be ol i talem se kava i flat finis long nakamal
bslGroup.mrl: Si ker nu-sur si në-mëlōp nu-bas vita le-gemel!
bslGroup.drg: La nēr m-vit ron̄ kak o ge m-bas nok dēn le gmāl.
bslGroup.lkn: To gēē 'n vis sa 'n qagogo 'n pah nok lē gamäl.

bslGroup.bsl: No, long haos blong mi, se!
bslGroup.drg: Bek! {A le gvur || Le gavruk} aē.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi gat wan rus bl'm i staon
Olgeta ol i bin pulumaot wan hed bl'm long maret, long las sarere
bslGroup.mrl: Ker mo-wës në-qōtōgi tuwel neweas, na-mar ker si-sim le-legleg, le-qōn̄ reveag,
bslGroup.drg: Nēr m-vut tuar qōtgin nēnēr vat le lāglēg le tuar sarere,
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē 'n avus too qētē qitgi nahnē le lägläg, le sarere ok ēn van nok,

bslGroup.bsl: trink bl. ol bigman ol i trink long nakamal
bslGroup.mrl: namar re mel lawo ker si-sim le-gemel.
bslGroup.drg: nēnēr vi-lilwo nēr s-sim le gmāl.
bslGroup.lkn: 'un'un na-n wēēwēē jaajun ga rēgrēg gēē ok a 'un le gamäl.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol i shud trink, be from ol i bin trink plante finis,
bslGroup.mrl: Si ker si-sim, lakan sur ker nu-sim soksok vita;
bslGroup.drg: Nēr kak sim, la sur nēr m-sim nok va-vvōr,
bslGroup.lkn: Sa gēē a 'un, la gēē ok ēn 'un siisa nok,

bslGroup.bsl: ale ol i givim long mi se trink blong mi.
bslGroup.mrl: lan ker ge-le m-no si nëmok.
bslGroup.drg: nēr m-la ma ron̄ kak innōk.
bslGroup.lkn: we gēē tē lä mun na sa 'n nak.

bslGroup.mrl: Në n-mërōs në s-wöl nen i marnag,
bslGroup.drg: Na va-mrōs kak na s-wōl dēn mrānga,
bslGroup.lkn: Na a maēs a wēl mun maranag °a°,

bslGroup.bsl: mi talem l. hem se "Yu no stap spolem yu!"
bslGroup.mrl: lan në n-werē si “Tokor {dede sēt || dada m̄erē} gineak!”
bslGroup.drg: na m-vit min ni ron̄ “{Tog || Te} dawdaw {rōrōw || matnerov} te nēk!”
bslGroup.lkn: na 'n vis mun nē sa “Mētē qiseg lee nēk!”

bslGroup.bsl: hem i SE "Nogat, i trink blong yu festaem!"

bslGroup.drg: Na ron̄ “Varean vilwo min nēk, mrānga!”
bslGroup.lkn: Na sa “Varean ga rēg mun nēk, maranag!”
bslGroup.mrl: No wa “Temtem nu-lap min neak, marnag!”

bslGroup.bsl: Be kava bl.yu ia, yumi2 bae i trink wetem huia?
bslGroup.drg: La non̄ o ge sa, gēn s-sim valrēg ma isē?
bslGroup.lkn: To 'n nan̄ qagogo heg, wōjō mēn too sē lēh?
bslGroup.mrl: Tu kēkē na-man̄ mëlōp, dōrō s-sim gean mi resē?

bslGroup.bsl: Be pikinini bl. yu, we boe ia?
bslGroup.drg: La i ntōn̄ nen̄ sa, o m̄erat sa?

bslGroup.bsl: No, hem i no save trink blong hem,
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē, sean bit sim tea naman,
bslGroup.drg: Bek, ni te sim late non,
bslGroup.lkn: Ta, { nē tē ron̄ vēgēl awōh male 'un'un || nē a 'un ēs avōh itä } qagogo,

bslGroup.bsl: Ol pikinini ol i no stap trink kava.
bslGroup.mrl: Re lōn̄lōm̄ēr ker ti-simsim mëlōp tea.
bslGroup.lkn: Wēē wēē miimiini gēē tē 'un'un avōh qagogo.

bslGroup.bsl: Bae hem i save nomo staon lukluk
bslGroup.mrl: Sean seseag risa gor gom dōrō.
bslGroup.drg: Ni s-tog wor ror ni s-tek.
bslGroup.lkn: Nē ga hag jurun̄ woo ēs wōjō tē 'un to.

bslGroup.bsl: Bae yumi2 i rerem olsem wanem?
Bae yumi2 i kakae i sofsof?
E, no! Nogut se bae yu trong l'm!
bslGroup.mrl: Tugutu! Tagor naqatōn̄ biti dem̄eli nea!
bslGroup.drg: Tog! Tekgor na qtōn̄ s-taqlil mi!
bslGroup.lkn: Oh, ta gēn! { Qatōn̄ mētē || 'Ätäwoo qatōn̄ ga } taqilqil mē!

bslGroup.drg: Na muk tuar vāt vatgin qisqis o ge aē.
bslGroup.lkn: Mok too vatpōn̄ ēhē avan qisis qagogo.

bslGroup.bsl: yumi2 bae i save kraonem kava i sofsof l'm
bslGroup.mrl: Dōrō s(e)-qesis mëlumlum lē në-mëlōp nea.
bslGroup.drg: Dār so-qsis m̄gisgis o ge { mi || ni }.
bslGroup.lkn: Wōjō a qisis m̄asoksok ēs qagogo mē nē a manoo.

bslGroup.bsl: Yu yu kraonem, ale mi mi kapsaetem wora
bslGroup.drg: Nēk so-qsis, na s-don̄ ror o bē.
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk ga qisis, na a jon̄ in tun̄ to lolon.

bslGroup.bsl: Tekem kaliko (bl.kokonas), ale skwisim blong sevem makas i kamaot
bslGroup.mrl: Lē në-dōtir, vvir vita nē-sēm̄ē tebēn.
bslGroup.drg: La ma o danir, na { s-wir || so-qrin̄ } sur o sam̄in s-van dēn.
bslGroup.lkn: Lä 'n n̄ii, nēk tē virih jen sam̄i avan ēhē.

bslGroup.bsl: Noyet! Yumi2 i trink finis, jas kakae
bslGroup.mrl: Tēqētea! Dōrō si-sim bas, qer gengen.
bslGroup.drg: Tuqa m̄o titi! Dār s-sim bas, dār qra gāngēn.
bslGroup.lkn: Ta male! Wōjō a 'un pah, lak gängän.

bslGroup.bsl: Sapos no / Sapos yu kakae festaem, kava bae i no save kilim yu i strong.
bslGroup.mrl: Kan si neak mi gengen am̄o, mëlōp bit-dawëk mēnmēn lē tea.
bslGroup.drg: Kak nēk m-gāngēn nok, o ge te daw tavul late nēk.
bslGroup.lkn: Sa nēk wōn a gängän m̄o, qagogo ga mäkä lekteg ēs avōh nēk.

bslGroup.bsl: Yumi mas lisen long kava festaem:
bslGroup.drg: Gēn s-rorn̄āg m̄o gor o ge.

bslGroup.bsl: maot i tiktik, hed i lus, bodi i hevi gut
bslGroup.mrl: nē-vēlēi su-ttum, ne-qeti se-dem̄eli, nē-lēbē sē-wēn mēnmēn.
bslGroup.drg: o valin to-ttum ti, o qātin t-taqilil ti, o turgin va-mmāt.
bslGroup.lkn: mōslēi a matlus, qatōi ga taqilqil, epäi ga mēhēg kere.

bslGroup.bsl: Be sipos kava i konkon long mi, mi no save kakae antap long hem?
bslGroup.mrl: Kan si nëmëlōp mi gëngën lë-vëlok, no biti gengen lē tea maken?
bslGroup.drg: La kak o ge va-ggon min na, na te gāngēn late gor?
bslGroup.lkn: Sa wōn qagogo won le valak, na gängän ēs avōh tuwoo maken?

bslGroup.bsl: Yes, yu save wasem-maot wetem kokonas o paenapol, o wanem?
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē! Neak se-ker lē na-valan̄ nean matō, se mē tēgē, ne-benap, si nasa?
bslGroup.drg: Bek, nēk s-gumgum lala na vlan̄ {gin || mi} o mtō, le o banav, le o sa(v)?
bslGroup.lkn: E, nēk ga wumwum ēs valan̄ mē 'n matu le 'n penav, le naha?

bslGroup.bsl: Yu no stap tingting tumas long hem.
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk mētē jēējēm siisa lee ēhē.

bslGroup.bsl: Yu kakae evriwan finis, ale bae yu save go slip wantaem!
bslGroup.mrl: Neak se-gengen bas, bas, neak qer van bo-n̄orn̄or vitwel!
bslGroup.drg: Nēk m-gāngēn bas, nēk so qra van n̄or atwal.
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk ga gängän vata pah, pah nēk lak van n̄oo vata.

bslGroup.bsl: Afta mi slip gut long hem?
bslGroup.lkn: Pah, na n̄oo kere ēs mē, le…?

bslGroup.bsl: Baee! Bae yu drim ia, bae i swit we i swit!
bslGroup.mrl: Ee! Neak së-qër kan, n-derm̄ōt lan n-derm̄ōt!
bslGroup.drg: Ee! Nēk s-qor sa, v-derm̄ōt v-derm̄ōt!
bslGroup.lkn: E! Nēk ga qoo siisa nen̄ { ga jērēm̄ōt sa ga jērēm̄ōt || ga wē sa ga wē }!

bslGroup.bsl: Be nomo se yu no stap trink tumas,
bslGroup.mrl: Kal-kan gom neak bit simsim megep,
bslGroup.lkn: La nen̄ °en° woo sa nēk mētē 'un'un siisa lee,

bslGroup.bsl: nogut se kava i faetem yu!
bslGroup.mrl: tagor si në-mëlōp bit da lin̄lin̄eak soksok!
bslGroup.drg: tekgor o ge s-daw rōrōw nēk.
bslGroup.lkn: { sa 'n ta qagogo ga || qagogo mētē } vuh siisa nēk.

bslGroup.bsl: 3-4 sel, ating bae i stret long yu,
bslGroup.mrl: Vunlas töl si ivet, wun sa-ttares miak,
bslGroup.drg: Kak o vni walas s-tōl (le) s-vāt, nen̄ en { va-sār || v-tatrēs } wedek {ma || min} nēk
bslGroup.lkn: Vinlah ni-tēl le ni-väs, wujek ga haj mun nēk,

bslGroup.bsl: from yu no lan gut long hem.
bslGroup.lkn: nēk ok le tē ron̄ kere avōh.

rfGroup.olr: Muk gasal tē on ti ve?

bslGroup.num: Magōrōs, { rar m̄er || rar tawa || kumur }!
{ Saven? || Ve-dese? }

bslGroup.bsl: Mi stap lukaotem wan naef bl. mi l. plesia
bslGroup.mtp: Nok soksok na-gasel mino vitwag me agōh,
bslGroup.num: Na t-ēl ti tuar gasel abene,
bslGroup.drg: Na t-ām namuk o masa ti aē sei,
bslGroup.olr: Na tē ēm tay gasal ti tav tēne,
bslGroup.lkn: Na tē äm mok too gahäl to vaan iheg,
bslGroup.mrl: No se-eleal nō-k gisel tuwel kel kē,

bslGroup.bsl: be yu2f. i stap staon l. mat ia, ating i staon-blokem naef
bslGroup.mtp: ba kōmyō hag tō {la-tamn̄a || la-tamge} nen en, qe so kōmyō ma-hag {goy || valqet} na-gasel.
bslGroup.num: kumur ve-sa le taban̄a kosen, wun kumur ve-sa {gor || amek} gasel namuk.
bslGroup.drg: kmur t-tog le tabn̄a sa ti, kmur wedek t-tog gor namuk o masa ti?
bslGroup.olr: kumuy tē saa ti le tapn̄a nan̄, wujēk kumuy tē saa woy ti gasal?
bslGroup.lkn: to gamuu tē hag to le tapn̄a nen̄, gamuu wujek tē hag tuwoo mok gahäl to.
bslGroup.mrl: kamrō segseag lē ēm n̄ea, bit kamrō nu-seag gor ni-gisel.

bslGroup.bsl: Yu2f. i traem stanap festaem mi luk?
bslGroup.mtp: Amyō hatig tog tō nok et tog?
bslGroup.num: Kumur ti tur °ta te° kērē?
bslGroup.drg: Ar togvut sē na s-tek sē?
bslGroup.olr: Kumuy tuy saa m̄o meken na tak ēl sa?
bslGroup.lkn: Gamuu turag tägäh m̄o toto na 'ätä tägäh?

bslGroup.bsl: I nogat wan naef l. plesia.
bslGroup.num: Bek, gasel bek abene.
bslGroup.drg: O, obek, o masa obek aē sa.
bslGroup.lkn: Óòó, gaiv, gahäl gaiv vaan heg.
bslGroup.mrl: Taga ti gisel tuwel kel kē.

bslGroup.bsl: Be from, mi bin katem wan paenapol l. hem samples l. plesia tedei.
bslGroup.mtp: O ba veg, no me-tep tō na-madap vitwag aē aqyig tege van agōh.
bslGroup.num: Bek, sur na me tev benav titwal ni ave-wun abene naqiri.
bslGroup.drg: Sur na °va nen̄° m-sis o tuar banav ni ave aē sei naqri.
bslGroup.olr: La suy, na m sēv tay paynap mē m̄areve ne naqri.
bslGroup.lkn: La on, na 'n sēp too penap mē have vaan heg tie.
bslGroup.mrl: O, sur no mē-tēv na-banav tuwel nea kēlkēl kel-kēkē neqerig.

bslGroup.bsl: Mitufela i kam, i no luk wan samting i stap.
bslGroup.mtp: Óòó, kamyō ma-van me en, tateh hap gōh.
bslGroup.num: Kamar ve-an ma, veta kērē mi saven abene.
bslGroup.drg: Kmār m-van ma, kmār s-tek tēmē o sa aē sei.
bslGroup.olr: Kēmēy van ma, kēmēy mō ēl sē: gaiv.
bslGroup.lkn: Gamaa 'n van me, gamaa tē 'ätä avōh too naha tē hag to vaan heg.
bslGroup.mrl: Kamar me-ven mē, (ka)mar ti mata sa ti mea kel kē.

bslGroup.bsl: Be wijwan naef ia, we yu stap lukaotem?
bslGroup.mtp: Wō na-han gasel qele nen, a nēk sok tō en?
bslGroup.num: Sav gasel nen nik tē-ēl ti?
bslGroup.drg: La o sav masa sa nen̄ nēk t-ām ti?
bslGroup.olr: La sav gasal nan̄ nēk tē ēm ti?
bslGroup.lkn: To naha gahäl inen̄ nēk tē äm to?

bslGroup.num: U gasel wiskit…

bslGroup.bsl: Hemia we sam man i bin presentem yu long hem l. Vila?
bslGroup.mtp: Wō mey a n-et vitwag ma-tapēva tō nēk aē a Vila ōk?
bslGroup.mrl: N̄elkan ne-tedun tuwel me-le m-neak Vila?
bslGroup.num: Gasel nen tuar tudun me le min nik a Vila?
bslGroup.drg: O masa gēn nen̄ sa tuar tdun m-la min nēk a Vila?
bslGroup.olr: Ni ēn nan̄ tay tujun̄ mō la mun nēk Vila?
bslGroup.lkn: Inen̄ ok too jaajun ēn tapeva mun nēk Vila?

bslGroup.num: Bek, tuar sēsē!

bslGroup.bsl: Hemia we yu stap talem ia, hem i stap long ples bl.mi ia, ananit long mat blong mi.
bslGroup.mtp: Mey a nēk vap tō en, kē hag tō a le-tnēk, a le-tno tamge mino antan.
bslGroup.num: Nik ti vit ti tuar sēsē nen, ve-sa a le { guvur namuk || navruk }, a-be tonon, a-llan̄ naba-k.
bslGroup.drg: Gēn nen̄ nēk t-vit sur ti, ni le namuk o gvur, nam lin̄rāg leln̄a tabn̄a namuk.
bslGroup.olr: M̄ay nēk tē vit ti surē nan̄, ni tē saa ti le muk { vuvuy || tono n̄oyn̄oy }, talva vēy.
bslGroup.lkn: Inen̄ ok nēk tē vis ēhē to, ni tē hag to le mok wihn̄i, lan̄i vēē mok.
bslGroup.mrl: N̄e kan neak sursur sur, nu-tog lē tentenōk, lan̄ muk ēm.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi stap slislip long hem blong i nogat man i stilim.
bslGroup.mtp: Nok mitimtiy goy den n-et taple bel.
bslGroup.num: Na te-n̄or ti a-meken tabe tudun manta bal le.
bslGroup.drg: Na t-n̄or gor ti tekor tuar tdun s-bāl.
bslGroup.olr: Na tē n̄oyn̄oy ti iē suy tujun̄ mētē pal ley.
bslGroup.lkn: Na tē n̄oon̄oo tuwoo to on jaajun mētē pal lee.
bslGroup.mrl: No s-n̄orn̄or gor sur tedun tuwel bit bël le tea.

bslGroup.bsl: Be naef we mi stap lukaotem naoia,
bslGroup.mtp: Ba na-gasel mey a nok soksok gōh en,
bslGroup.num: Gasel na tē ēl ti a noknok e,
bslGroup.drg: La o masa na t-ām ti aē sa,
bslGroup.olr: La gasal na tē ēm ti noknok ne,
bslGroup.lkn: La gahäl na ok tē äm to noknok heg,

bslGroup.num: balēn ve-mommogor,

bslGroup.bsl: mo bled bl'm i sap lelbit.
bslGroup.num: na-nogon ve-sser gele.
Aa, na ve-dōm wun!
bslGroup.lkn: O, wuswē! Na 'n jējēm gēn gēn ek!

bslGroup.bsl: Tedei l. medeldei, mi luk samman i holem, wan pikinini.
bslGroup.mtp: Aqyig lēlwomyen, no m-et n-et vitwag nē-tēy, nētm̄ey su vitwag.
bslGroup.num: Naqiri a le maren ve-llav, na me kērē tudun titwal vē-tēr, tuar m̄am̄m̄ari.
bslGroup.drg: Naqri le tetne mrān, na m-tek tuar tdun me-tur, tuar m̄erm̄er.
bslGroup.olr: Naqri, le tina meren, na m ēl tay tujun̄ mō gis, tay putē.
bslGroup.lkn: Tie lē sini { ähat || maarän }, na 'n 'ätä too jaajun tē gih to, too miini.
bslGroup.mrl: Qerig lē tinersat, no m-mata ne-tedun tuwel nu-tör, nō-lōm̄ēr tuwel.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i karem i go insaed l. haos daon ia [yow]
bslGroup.mtp: Kē ma-van tēy bat hay lelo ēm̄ yow en.
bslGroup.num: Ni mē-tēr ni ve-kal ve-sa a le guvur ror in.
bslGroup.drg: Ni m-la ni m-van mi le tuar gvur ror gēn.
bslGroup.olr: Ni m-gis ni m-van mē le tay vuvuy roy ēn.
bslGroup.lkn: Nē 'n gih nē tē ol mē lē um̄ä rōkōw rek.
bslGroup.mrl: Sean mē-lē sar lē ean̄ kos n̄ē { ki vel || ki sea }.

bslGroup.bsl: Traem luk insaed, mebi hem i lego i stap yet?
bslGroup.mtp: Nēk et tog hay en, kē wun m-ukēg tō hag lepgetō?
bslGroup.num: Kēr laēs a-llon, ni wun °ve-le ti° ti ave (a le guvur) en?
bslGroup.drg: Tek sē { allon || agvur } nen̄, ni wedek m-sakra t' agvur nen̄?
bslGroup.olr: Ēl sē tē lolon, wujēk ti on mele?
bslGroup.lkn: 'Ätä tägäh to lolon, ni wujek ēn ukäg tē nen̄?
bslGroup.mrl: Mata eal sar kan, bit kan sean kovta sar kan?

bslGroup.num: O guvur { kosē || ror in }?

bslGroup.bsl: No, long saed i kam antap lelbit.
bslGroup.mtp: Óòó, malig se hay me gēn.
bslGroup.num: Bek, gele ta usur kal ma.
Kosē?
Ni nen wa!

bslGroup.bsl: I gat? Yu faenem? - Wet festaem...
bslGroup.mtp: Aē? Nēk m-ekas? - { Dēyē tō || Makōstō }…
bslGroup.num: Aben? Nik vē-kērē? - Tuqa…
bslGroup.drg: Aē? Nēk m-van wōn? - Tuqa m̄o titi…
bslGroup.olr: Iē? Nēk mō ēl? - Asval ti…

bslGroup.bsl: Nogat, mi no luk wan naef insaed ia!
bslGroup.mtp: Óòó, tateh, nok et-etsas te na-gasel vitwag alon gōh.
bslGroup.num: Bek, na veta kērē mi gasel abene.
bslGroup.drg: Obek, na s-tek tēmē o masa allon sa.
bslGroup.olr: Gaiv, na tē ēl wōs gasal tav tēne.
bslGroup.lkn: Ta, na tē 'ätä avōh too gahäl vaan heg.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē, ne ti-mata tea ni-gisel tuwel kel kē.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i no stap hang antap l. natangura? - Nogat.
bslGroup.mtp: Wō et-vēhbeg kal te hag lo-yot alge? - Tateh.
bslGroup.num: Veta gasle mi abe dutukur? - Bek. (Ni veta le ti mi abene.)
bslGroup.drg: Ni vte gaslēg tēmē gin o mat da-tkōr? - Obek.
bslGroup.olr: Tē taka wōs meken jajkōy? - Gaiv.
bslGroup.lkn: Tē huweg avōh maken on mähä jajakōō? - Gaiv.
bslGroup.mrl: Sean tagatea bō-do-takōr ki seag? - Tēgē, tagatea.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i no stap ledaon ananit, klosap l. stonoven? - Nogat bakegen.
bslGroup.mtp: Et-enen te hōw lē-vētan antan, isqet van le-qyēn̄i? - Tateh se.
bslGroup.num: Ni veta liti mi a le tan, valbēt wēm? - Bek abene.
bslGroup.drg: Ni obek le tan, vrigtēg māln̄ē o um? - Obek va gēn.
bslGroup.olr: Ni tē on wōs lē lep, rivtaa qētē num? - Gaiv mula.
bslGroup.lkn: Nē tē en avōh vaan rigtäg um? - Ta, gaiv lēh.
bslGroup.mrl: Sean ti ën tea { bēt në-vët wōnwōdōn̄ || bēt n-um }? - Tagatea kēl.

bslGroup.bsl: Be olsem wanem l. bokis-bl-kakae, antap l. faia?
bslGroup.mtp: Ba qele ave lo-m̄oto, a le-mte ep en?
bslGroup.num: Wat ve-de(ge)se sur bugor, a-mek wev?
bslGroup.drg: Nēk tek sē a le bgor nen̄, a mke { um || āv }?
bslGroup.olr: La gasva suy pugoy, mēkē putēv?
bslGroup.mrl: Ba gasva bō-bōgōr sakan mak ev?

bslGroup.bsl: No, i gat nomo wan bag bl. nangae.
bslGroup.num: Bek, u bak n̄a am (a le bugor) a-llon.
bslGroup.drg: Obek. Tuar o get n̄a wor aē sa.
bslGroup.olr: Taga. Tay wogavgav n̄a woy iē.
bslGroup.lkn: Ta, gaiv, too gävgäv wet woo ēhē.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē, tagate gisel kel kē, ne-beak n̄ē tuwal gom kel kē.

bslGroup.bsl: Fak, mi kros long smol kokmit ia!
bslGroup.mtp: Awō! No mo-boel woqey su en, qe so na-lwan!
bslGroup.num: Nallok ve an m̄am̄m̄ari!
bslGroup.drg: Nallōk m-kot o m̄erm̄er nen̄ sa!
bslGroup.olr: Lōlōk te kot ti putē nan̄!
bslGroup.lkn: Oh! Lolok tē kot {miini asik || ēn wan̄} to irek!

bslGroup.num: Ey! Nik te kal titi ma!
bslGroup.lkn: E! Nēk ēt row ol m̄o ma!

bslGroup.bsl: Pikinini ia, hem i stap wokbaot i go antap ia.
bslGroup.mtp: Nē-nētm̄ey en, kē vatag { hay || hag }.
bslGroup.num: M̄am̄m̄ari en { te an kal ti sa in || te an ti van e }.
bslGroup.drg: M̄erm̄er nen̄ sa gēn, ni m-van barbar gēn vak.
bslGroup.olr: Putē nan̄ { tē van kal ti saa nan̄ || ni tē van paytaa ti vak ēn }.
bslGroup.lkn: Miini nen̄, { tē van ajew gēn hag || tē van päätäg gēn päh }.
bslGroup.mrl: Lōm̄ēr sean sea kel kē, { se-venven seag || sa-vanvan van }.

bslGroup.num: Vavar laēs ma ni!

bslGroup.mtp: Ey, mey nu-su! Van tō me gōh!
bslGroup.num: E! M̄am̄m̄ari! { Van titi ma || Van ma ti! }
bslGroup.lkn: E! Miini ga sik! Row m̄o ma (toto)!

bslGroup.bsl: Yu nao we i stilim naef blong mi?
bslGroup.mtp: Inēk a me-bel na-gasel mino en?
bslGroup.num: Nik nen me bal gasel namuk?
bslGroup.drg: Nēk gēn nen̄ m-bāl namuk o masa le?
bslGroup.olr: Nēk ēn nan̄ mō pal muk gasal?
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk gēn nen̄ nēk ēn pal mok gahäl?
bslGroup.mrl: Neak n̄ealkan { më-bël || mo-tova } nō-k gisel?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi no "stilim" ia, mi ting se blong mi.
bslGroup.mtp: Óòó, nok et-bel te, nok dēm so mino.
bslGroup.num: Na veta bal mi, na ve-dōm si namuk.
bslGroup.drg: Obek, na m-te bāl tēmē, na me-dōm kak namuk.
bslGroup.olr: Taga! Na tē pal wōs, na jējēm ka muguk.
bslGroup.lkn: Ta gēn, na tē pal avōh, ta tē jēm to sa mok.
bslGroup.mrl: Në ti-{bël || tova} ti mea, në dōm si nönōk.

bslGroup.num: Nik ve-gal am!
bslGroup.lkn: O, nēk tē gäl woo to!

bslGroup.num: Bek, na { vi-dun || vi-vit dun }!
bslGroup.olr: Taga, na tē vit ti vutwē!

bslGroup.bsl: Yu no stap kros long mi!
bslGroup.num: Na-llon̄ tog ve-anan na!
bslGroup.drg: Na llon̄ tog kotkot te na!

bslGroup.mtp: No ne-myōs ēwē so siseg aē.
bslGroup.num: Na ve-mōrōs am te oror ni.
bslGroup.olr: Na ga mērēs pipira woy mē.
bslGroup.lkn: Na ga marēs woo ga 'oo'oo mē.

bslGroup.bsl: Be naef i no pleple bl. ol pikinini, smol kokmit!
bslGroup.mtp: Ba na-gasel et-siseg namun ige susu te, woqey su!
bslGroup.num: U gasel veta oror nam ra mel m̄am̄m̄ari mi!
bslGroup.drg: O masa, oror nami m̄erm̄er tēmē!
bslGroup.olr: La gasal tē pipira { wōs moy putputē || moy putputē wōs }.
bslGroup.lkn: La gahäl (nen̄) atē 'oo'oo avōh moo wēē miimiini, wan̄!
bslGroup.mrl: Ni-gisel ti-oror mur re lōn̄lōm̄ēr tea, nagan̄ te gom!

bslGroup.bsl: Mi no wan pikinini, mi bigwan finis!
bslGroup.mtp: Nok et-su te, no may liwo!
bslGroup.num: Na veta m̄am̄m̄ari mi, na ve-llav vata!
bslGroup.drg: Na tuar m̄erm̄er tēmē, na va-lwo nok!
bslGroup.olr: Na tē putē wōs, na aqasgi nok!
bslGroup.lkn: Na atē miini avōh, na ga qahgi nok!
bslGroup.mrl: Në ti-lōm̄ēr tea, no nu-lav vita.

bslGroup.bsl: Kas! Be naef ia i stap wea?
bslGroup.mtp: Ēt! Ba na-gasel nan (hag tō) ave?
bslGroup.num: Oh! Nek, gasel ave nek?
bslGroup.drg: La o masa nen̄ m-tog ave?
bslGroup.olr: A, la gasal nan̄ tē on ti ve?
bslGroup.lkn: Oh, la gahäl nen̄ tē hag to have?

bslGroup.bsl: Long plesia! Mi stap holem ia.
bslGroup.num: Kose! Na tē-tēr ti.
bslGroup.olr: Iē ne! Na tē gis ti ne.
bslGroup.lkn: Vaan heg, na tē gih to heg.

bslGroup.num: Le ma (tam)tamul!
Ya, le at! - Ni nen wa.

bslGroup.bsl: Yu no stap tekem bakegen ol stg bl. ol naraman!
bslGroup.mtp: Nēk tog leplep se na-haphap non ige tegha.
bslGroup.num: Nik tog ve-lele mēlē savasav nam tuar tudun.
bslGroup.drg: Tog nēk v-lala mlē o vrin̄rin̄ nami ra tuar tdun.
bslGroup.olr: Nēk mētē lala ley mula vrojroj mo tujun̄ vagēs.
bslGroup.lkn: Nēk mētē lälä lēh lee viiviirin̄ moo wēē ōjēn jaajun.
bslGroup.mrl: Tokor lēlē kēl na-savsav mur re tuar tedun.

bslGroup.num: Ve-bon̄. - Ale, nik te van den!
Keti Rovōgōl (60) + Antonet Rovanle (18)

bslGroup.bsl: Yumitu storian l. saed bl. ol devil.
bslGroup.lkn: Wōjō ga suusuu on gēē wēē tan̄ro.

bslGroup.bsl: Taem wan man i ded, yumi berem bodi bl'm i stap l. gref bl'm
bslGroup.drg: °O tdun m-mat, tvig ni {le armatur || le na qōrqōrōn || le na qirqiri pupu}.
bslGroup.kro: Tudun m-mat, tivig ni {le armatur || le na-qōrqōrōn || le na-qirqiri pupu}.
bslGroup.lkn: Lē wēhn̄i jaajun ga mät, gēj a tivig epen to le qarōn, lē peret n̄oon̄oo.

bslGroup.bsl: ol famle bl'm i krae l'm, mo ol i kakae dei bl'm
bslGroup.drg: °I r-ten̄ten̄ren m-tān̄ sur ni, nēr t-gān na mtan ti.
bslGroup.kro: Ra tēn̄tēn̄ren m-arra sur ni, nēr t-gän na-matan ti.
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē wēē seksekren ga rara 'uh nē, gēē tē gän metan.

bslGroup.bsl: Sipos olgeta i no mekem ol samting we i stret,
bslGroup.drg: °Nēr vit daw late o vrin̄rin̄ vēwē,
bslGroup.kro: Nēr t-daw wōs mē o vronron wē,
bslGroup.lkn: Sa gēē wōn gatē vä avōh viiviirin̄ ga tawolwol,

bslGroup.bsl: spirit bl'm bae i no save go long Ples-bl.-ol-ded (Panoi)
bslGroup.lkn: talatēn atē van ēsavōh {lē Worehōō || Panē}.

bslGroup.bsl: Bae hem i stap wokbaot olbaot/nating nomo l. wol bl. yumi ia
bslGroup.drg: °Ni s-van kēlkēl wor le mram ne.
bslGroup.kro: Ni s-van kēlkēl wor l-maram ne.
bslGroup.lkn: Nē ga van {kēlkēl || sälēn} woo lē mongēj maram heg.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale hem i kam wan devil
bslGroup.drg: °Ni o tmat gēn nok nen̄ le.
bslGroup.kro: Ni o tamat ēn nok nen̄ le.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol devil i save spolem man, mo ol i save kakae man
bslGroup.drg: °O tmat ni t-daw rōrōw ti o tdun, ti ni t-gān ti o tdun.
bslGroup.kro: O tamat ni v-daw väläkräg ti o tudun, ti ni v-gän o tudun.
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē wēē tan̄ro gēē (ga) qisäg ēs jaajun, to gēē ga gän ēs jaajun.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol i mekem man i fraet, espeseli long naet
bslGroup.drg: °Nēr t-daw ti o tdun s-matwut, raksag lē qōn̄.
bslGroup.kro: Nēr v-daw o tudun v-matwut, wēswor l-qōn̄.
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē (ga) vä ēs jaajun ga matwus, rakasag on qēn̄.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol devil ia, i no stap olbaot l. vilej,
bslGroup.drg: °O tmat nen̄ nēr s-tog kēlkēl tēmē { le m̄sa || le vre },
bslGroup.kro: O tamat nen̄ nēr t-sa kēlkēl wōs la-m̄as,
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē wēē tan̄ro inen̄, gēē tē hag {kēlkēl || sälēn} avōh le vanō,

bslGroup.bsl: i gat spesel ples bl'm long aelan (l.bush, l.sanbij...)
bslGroup.drg: °tru tānēnēr sutwal wor aē a mke grāt,
bslGroup.kro: na-turu tonor vutwal wor iē l-meke gärät,
bslGroup.lkn: tirig tanoo (wēē tan̄ro) ēhē le gawon.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol i kolem ples ia se ol "..."
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē tē vis to wēhn̄i nen̄ sa “Lē ga sa”.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol ples ia i gat denja, yu no stap wokbaot l'm l. naet
bslGroup.drg: °O wasn̄in nen̄, o mtewot aē, nēk vte vanvan late aē le qōn̄.
bslGroup.kro: O wasn̄i nen̄, o metewot iē, nēk t-vanvan ler iē l-qōn̄.
bslGroup.lkn: Wēē wēhn̄i nen̄ matewot ēhē, nēk mētē vanvan lee ēhē on qēn̄.

bslGroup.bsl: Sipos yu go, majik-pawa (mana?) bl. ol spirit hem i save mekem se hed bl.yu i lus, o wanem?
bslGroup.drg: °Nēk s-van aē, na lalvi tmat s-daw na mon̄ o dōdōm so-tger, le s-daksav?
bslGroup.kro: Nēk v-van iē, {na lalvi tmat || na lalvēr} v-daw nēk na-mon̄ o dōdōm v-tēgē, le v-dawsa?
bslGroup.lkn: Sa nēk wōn ga van ēhē, {man || lalvi} at ēhē a qis lolhil ēs qa'tōn̄, le ga gähä?

bslGroup.bsl: Be taem bl. (kolekole), ol devil i aot l. bush ol i kam tanis long ples-bl-vilej.
bslGroup.drg: °S-van ma le wasn̄in m̄rag s-kol o tmat, o tmat nēr s-togvut le m̄ōs nēr s-van ma le sar nēr s-lak aē.
bslGroup.kro: V-van ma l-wasn̄i ak m̄ar v-kol o tamat, o tmat nēr v-tävräkät le-vwon nēr v-van ma l-sar nēr v-lak iē.
bslGroup.lkn: Lē wēhn̄i gēj ga gih too kolkol, gēē wēē tan̄ro gēē ga van jen lē gawon gēē ga van lak ma lē (mongēj) saa.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol i tanis raon, gooogo, ale ol i gobak l. ples bl. olgeta
bslGroup.drg: °Nēr s-lak wālōg o wkordun̄ avvan, ti nēr s-van kēl mlē le tanēnēr.
bslGroup.kro: Nēr v-lak dälgēt o wokor vavvan, ti nēr v-van kēl mala l-tonor.
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē 'n lak jilis va#van, pah gēē tē van lōk le moo {vanō || wēhn̄i}.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol man we ol i pem devil long sukwe, olgeta nao ol i gatraet [lês] bl. "holem devil" lg salagoro.
bslGroup.drg: °O tdun sa nēr me vsōk nēr, nēr s-wōl o tmat gēn nen̄, nēr gēn nen̄ nēr o qtē tmat vatgin le salgor le, nēr s-tur lala o tmat.
bslGroup.kro: O tudun ka nēr v-vōsōk nēr, nēr v-wōl o tamat ēn nen̄, nēr ēn nen̄ nēr o qētē tamat vet l-salgor le, nēr v-tur wēs o tamat.
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē wēē jaajun ok gēē {'n hēw salwoo || 'n van lē vasōk}, gēē gēn nen̄ gēē ga haj {on || mēn} ga gih ätmät.

bslGroup.bsl: Be samting ia i tabu tumas, yumi no save tokbaot olbaot we ol pikinini mo ol woman i stap.
bslGroup.drg: °La o vrin̄rin̄ nen̄ o tāb ve-ggon gor, gēn vte saror kēlkēl late gor na ngē ra rqa ma ē r' m̄erm̄er.
bslGroup.kro: La o vronron nen̄ o täm vo-ggon gor, gēn v-saror kēlkēl wōs mē gor nēgē rat-lorqa mē rat totogo.
bslGroup.lkn: La nanvä' inen̄, ga wowon siisa, gēj gatē suu sälēn ēsavōh ēhē lē wēhn̄i mē'mē'ni mēn gamgamtō ēhē.

bslGroup.bsl: Ankel bl. mi hem i stap katkatem kenu i go l. ol man l. vilej.
bslGroup.num: Tata na-muk te tsōn̄ ti wak min nir avere.
bslGroup.drg: Maru-k ni t-tartar o ak ti min ra tdun le vre.
bslGroup.lkn: Maru-k tē täätärä 'n ak to avan lē sul avan lē vanō.

bslGroup.bsl: Sapos wan man i askem l. hem, ale hem i go antap l. bush,
bslGroup.num: Si tuar tudun qe varus ni, ma ni tov van le vewon,
bslGroup.drg: Kak tuar sē m-vārus dēn ni, titi ni so van sag lē m̄ōs.
bslGroup.lkn: Sa too sē ga vaavuh jen nē, nē ga van ajew lē gawon.

bslGroup.bsl: faenem 1 tri we i fit gut, ale hem i katkros i foldaon l. graon
bslGroup.num: ni tov kērē tuar rega ve-ser tavul, ma ni tov tar tov so le tan.
bslGroup.drg: M-van wōn tuar o rga sa v-tatrēs tatavul, titi ni so tar ni so sōv barbar ror le tan.
bslGroup.lkn: Ätä too rägä sa ga haj kere, ni ga tärä tē sēv hōw lē tanē.

bslGroup.bsl: Finis, hem i tekem aj, i katem bodi bl. kenu wetem, googo...
bslGroup.num: Bas, ni tov le tala, ni tov tar na-turgi wak, va#van,
bslGroup.drg: Bas, ni so la o tla, ni so tar o turgi ak ni, va#van,
bslGroup.lkn: Pah, ni ga lä 'n tälä, ni tē tärä 'n epe(n) ak mē, va#van,

bslGroup.bsl: Katem aotsaed bl'm, hed bl'm mo as bl'm
bslGroup.num: Tar avere taben, tar na-qutun, tar na-keren
bslGroup.drg: Tar a vre (va) t-aē, na-qtōn, bas na-kren
bslGroup.lkn: tärä 'n liwi {ak || avan ēhē}, {qaatōn || qätä ak} to 'n {keren || kere ak}.

bslGroup.bsl: Katkatem finis, hem i digim insaed bl. wud.
bslGroup.num: tar bas avere, ni tov tun̄ a le wak.
bslGroup.drg: Ni m-tar bas, ni so dōrwalas le rga.
bslGroup.lkn: Täätärä pah, nē lak gil lē qaan̄ēn rägä.

bslGroup.bsl: Be wok ia, man i no save mekem l. wan dei nomo: ples i tudak (l. hem)!
bslGroup.num: Mumugu en, tudun manta takēlē le a le { qōn̄ || maren } titwal am : mas qōn̄gor ni.
bslGroup.drg: O mumgu nen̄, o tdun te daw late wor le mrān sutwal : o m̄sa m-qōn̄ gor ni.
bslGroup.lkn: La 'n mugmugu nen̄, jaajun ga mäkä ēsavōh on qēn̄ tuwa: {nagēm̄as || naēm̄as || lē} ga hil tuwoo nē!

bslGroup.num: Te le le qōn̄ ti-tōl si te-vet ran!
bslGroup.drg: S-la lala o mrān s-tōl le s-vāt.
bslGroup.lkn: Ni a lä ēs qēn̄ ni tēl le ni väs vata ēhē.

bslGroup.bsl: Taem bodi bl.kenu i kat finis, ale (taem) bl. mekem nasama nao!
bslGroup.num: Na-turgi wak ve-bas vata, noknoke takēlē sam.
bslGroup.drg: M̄rag o turgi o ak m-bas, ni so {tar || tsōn̄} i ntōn.
bslGroup.lkn: Epe ak ēn (tärä) pah nok, lak {mäkä 'n || tasun̄ ēn} sam gēn ek!

bslGroup.bsl: Mekem googo, finis ale katem rel bl. kenu, wetem ol smosmol stik bl'm
bslGroup.num: Tsōn̄ va#van, tov bas tov takēlē witi, vaten bisbōtot taben.
bslGroup.drg: Ni me tsōn̄ va#van, bas ni so tar o wtē valrēg o bibsi btot t-aē.
bslGroup.lkn: Tasun̄ va#van, pah lak tasun̄ lēwtē, mēn pisimotot avan ēhē.

bslGroup.bsl: Mo faenem wan rop blong fasem evriwan i strong
bslGroup.num: Kērē tuar ga, vivis tabe nir te mmartig.
bslGroup.drg: Ni so van wōn o gawol sur so lvit marmar bas.
bslGroup.lkn: To lak ätä 'n too gawutägä on ga vivih lekteg gēē.

bslGroup.num: Bas, wos am ti nen (tabe titsōn̄).
bslGroup.drg: Bas, o wos gēn wor {nok dek || mlēti}.

bslGroup.bsl: Afta i finis, hem i taem bl. pulum kenu i godaon l. solwora.
bslGroup.num: Bas nen, ma tov rev tēqēl wak ror le naw.
bslGroup.drg: Titi so bas, ni so rev swēl o ak ror a le naw.
bslGroup.lkn: Pah, ruruh sēwēl hōw ak to lē naw.

bslGroup.bsl: Sapos yu laekem, yu save pul i go (aot) l. dipsi tu l'm
bslGroup.num: Nik qe mōrōs, nik te su tēqēl le *veni* le lam.
bslGroup.drg: Kak nēk va-mrōs soqsoq, nēk so-sō swēl lala mlē ror le lam ni.
bslGroup.lkn: Sa nēk a marēs, nēk a sō (sēwēl) ēs to lē sēnē naw mē.

bslGroup.bsl: Olgeta bl. bifo ol i (save) tekem lif-pandanas ale somap wan sel, ale haesem l. mas, blong SEL l'm
bslGroup.num: Nir t' am̄o nir ve-le dotan̄ nir tov vat ni wem nir tov rev kal abe turga tabe nir ve-sol len̄.
bslGroup.drg: I ra t-am̄o nēr m-la o dawrut nēr so lēv tuar o eb, so rev kal gin o turga, sur sol (o) lān̄ ni.
bslGroup.lkn: Gēē at m̄o gēē ga lä ēs jawi jajan̄, tē lēv ēn too ap, tē vivih ajew to 'n tōōgä, on a tēgēn län̄ mē.

bslGroup.bsl: Sipos l. dei, ol i save fasin bl. win, ol i sel folem rot bl'm.
bslGroup.num: Si qe a le maren, nir vi-ggil na-sala len̄, nir ve-van usur na-salan.
bslGroup.drg: Kak le mrān, nēr va-vrēgēl kak o sav sal vatgin o lān̄ ti nēr so sol srēg na-slan.
bslGroup.lkn: Sa on maarän, gēē ga ron̄ kere 'n matalē län̄, gēē lak tēgēn suusuu.

bslGroup.bsl: Sipos l. naet, ol i lukluk nomo ol sta i stap saen antap l. skae,
bslGroup.num: Si qe a le qōn̄, nir vē-kērē usur wivti te ser ti amek milig,
bslGroup.drg: La kak lē qōn̄, nēr m-tek wor o wavtō to-dn̄ēr t' amke blō,
bslGroup.lkn: Sa on qēn̄, gēē ga jurun̄ woo to 'n wēēwēē m̄ähä tē hēn̄ to maken lē malēg,

bslGroup.bsl: ale ol i luk save wantaem rot bl'olgeta.
bslGroup.num: Bas nir vē-kērē lin̄lin̄i na-salanir.
bslGroup.lkn: to gēē tē ätä vērēgēl vata {moo || mongēē} alē.

bslGroup.bsl: Be naoia i finis, i nomo gat selkenu nao.
bslGroup.num: Noknoke ve-bas, wak wem bek vata nek.
bslGroup.drg: Dēk gēn, bas nok, o ak o eb bek nok ē.
bslGroup.lkn: La noknok heg, ēn pah nok, °tēgēn ak° gaiv nok gēn ek.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol bigfela sip i kam finis, olsem Kotu.
bslGroup.num: Bakalav ve-llallav ve-an (v)ata ma, tan̄ni sa Kotu.
bslGroup.drg: Tuar o ak va-lwo m-van nok ma, m̄rag o ak Kotu.
bslGroup.lkn: Wēēwēē ak ga rēgrēg ēn van nok ma gēn ek, m̄ērē sa Kotu.

bslGroup.num: Ken Stiven (34)

bslGroup.bsl: Ples i tudak, be [qe so] tufela man [yoge] i stap rao longwe long nasara
bslGroup.mrl: Lētneak silsileag, ne m̄erlē ne-tedun irō se velvelēlē vel-n̄ē le sar.
bslGroup.drg: O m̄sa va sil, la m̄rag wa o tdun s-rō {t-vatur || to-vlala} vak seg le sar ti.
bslGroup.olr: Nōgōtuqē mō sil nok, la m̄ay jujun̄ ni-rō tē vayle ti lē say.
bslGroup.lkn: Nagēm̄as ga hil nok, la m̄ērē sa jaajun ni rō tē rule to lē saa.

bslGroup.drg: Ey! Vatog gēn to-vgat vōvgōl ti?
bslGroup.olr: Votoo ēn nan̄ tē vōōvōgōl ti nan̄?
bslGroup.lkn: E! Vatog gēn nen̄ tē vagvagēl to nen̄?

bslGroup.drg: {Na-m̄lak m-row dēn || Na tō-dōm soqsoq ti sur}!

bslGroup.bsl: Mi ting se hem i stap tok strong long wan man,
bslGroup.mrl: Ne n-dōm si sean se-menmenes mermer bë-tëdun tuwel,
bslGroup.drg: Na m°ē°-dōm kak ni to-vgat marmar min tuar tdun ti,
bslGroup.olr: Na m-jējēm ka nē tē luw kotkot mun tay sē ti,
bslGroup.lkn: Na 'n jējēm sa nē tē luw lekteg to mun too sē,

bslGroup.bsl: hem i stap kros long hem.
Hem i kros from graon, o wanem?
bslGroup.mrl: Sean lëlën sur tan, si sur sa?
bslGroup.drg: Na-llon m-kot sur o tan, le (kak) o sa?
bslGroup.olr: Lolon tē kot ti suy lep, le suy sa?
bslGroup.lkn: Lolon tē kot to 'n tanē, le naha?

bslGroup.bsl: Nogat, hem i salus nomo from waef bl'm
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē, sean sō-dōdōm gor gom ronatōn.
bslGroup.drg: Obek, ni tō-dōm rōrōw wor sur namon o rqa ti.
bslGroup.olr: Taga, nē tē jējēm woy woy ti suy mon raqa.
bslGroup.lkn: Ta, nē tē jējēm woo woo suu 'n mon gamtō to.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i bin harem man ia i tok krangke long woman bl'm,
bslGroup.mrl: Sean mo-rron̄ ne-tedun sean menmenes teltel min ronatōn,
bslGroup.drg: Ni m-ron̄ o tdun nen̄ me-vgat rōrōw min namon o rqa,
bslGroup.olr: Nē m-ron̄ jujun̄ nan̄ valvalaw ga sa mēn mon raqa,
bslGroup.lkn: Nē 'n ron̄ i vä nen̄ nē 'n {valvala || luw} ga sa mēn mon gamtō,

bslGroup.bsl: Awuu! Yu luk? Tugeta i stap faet nao!
bslGroup.mrl: Au! Mata! Karar tara nu-ros lakan!
bslGroup.drg: Awē! Tek ka nen̄! Rār t-vatur nok ti!
bslGroup.olr: Au! Nēk ēl vak nan̄? Nōrō tē vatuy nok ti!
bslGroup.lkn: Au! Nēk ēt ätä päh nen̄? Wōrō tē vaatuu nok to!

bslGroup.bsl: Hemia we i strong hem i wantem pusum narawan i foldaon long graon.
bslGroup.mrl: Tuar mermer nu-mërōs tëm së tuar la-tan.
bslGroup.drg: (Tek ka nen̄!) Tuar nen̄ v-marmar ni so-qrēt sōv tuar le tan dek le.
bslGroup.olr: Tay ga maymay nē ga mērēs a qērēt tul tay ti le lep.
bslGroup.lkn: Too ok ga lekteg nē ga marēs ga qērēs sēv tuan too lē tanē.

bslGroup.bsl: Tugeta i pulum hea blong tugeta bakegen.
bslGroup.mrl: Karar tara { se-vel-rēprēp || sē-rēprēp } nu-vulrar kēl.
bslGroup.olr: Nōrō tē { ran̄ || va-ran̄ran̄ } vulōrō ti.
bslGroup.lkn: Wōrō tē ran̄ran̄ nok { vōlōōrō || vōlōnwōrō } to.

bslGroup.bsl: E! Klosap hem i kilim fes bl'm, hem i kilim mestem.
bslGroup.mrl: Nownow tit-tu nanagon, sean mu-tu rës.
bslGroup.drg: E! Vrigtēg ni {v-vus || va-ttuw} na-ngon, ni {m-vus || me-ttuw} vsēl.
bslGroup.olr: Ey! Ga rivtaa nē ga vus nogon tay, ni m-vus av.
bslGroup.lkn: E! Rigtäg too ga vuh nawon too, nē 'n vuh av.

bslGroup.bsl: Sipos we i bin kilim ae bl'm, ating bae tija i save kam blaen long hem!
bslGroup.mrl: Si sean tu-tut tu namatan, m̄er-kan i vatog meteqēl nea vitwel.
bslGroup.drg: Ni vit {vus na-mtan || ttuw na-mtan || vē-vsēl te}, m̄rag vatog na-mtan v-qel ni!
bslGroup.olr: Ka ni n-vus purē matan, tapurē votog matan ga qel ēs mē!
bslGroup.lkn: {Sa nē tē vuh av purē avōh || Sa 'n vuh purē 'n matan}, tapurē vatog matan ga won ēs mē.

bslGroup.bsl: O be nogat, kros bl. 2geta i kamdaon finis,
bslGroup.mrl: O tēgē, tagatea, nirar lëlën nu-sōw (bas) vita,
bslGroup.drg: Obek, namirār o lolkotkot m-sōv nok,
bslGroup.olr: O, gaiv, lolkotkot morō mō jēv suy nok,
bslGroup.lkn: Oh, ta! Lolkot monwōrō ēn hēw nok,

bslGroup.bsl: jif i stanap blokem tugeta finis.
bslGroup.olr: maranaga mō tuy nok woy nōrō.
bslGroup.lkn: maranag ēn tuu tuwoo {wōrō nok || nok wōrō}.

bslGroup.bsl: Naoia jif nao i stap raosem tugeta!
bslGroup.drg: Dēkēn, o mranga to-vgat ma rār ti.
bslGroup.olr: Noknok ne, maranaga tē rule mē nōrō ti.
bslGroup.lkn: Noknok heg maranag(a) gēn tē put nok wōrō to!

bslGroup.drg: Tam̄rag wa o m̄erm̄er atwal wor!

bslGroup.bsl: Eh, trigeta! Yu3f. i kam we?
bslGroup.num: E! Ratōl { m̄er || tawa }! Kōmtōl ve-an ma ave?
bslGroup.drg: E! Tōlm̄er! Tōlkmi m-van ma ave?
bslGroup.olr: Ava! (E! Kēlkimi pul tēl!) Kēlkimi te van ma ave?
bslGroup.lkn: E! Tēlēē-at! Tēlēmu tē van ma have?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi3f. i bin stap l. karen bl.mi3f.,
bslGroup.num: Kamatōl me sasa le wetan nam-matōl.
bslGroup.olr: Kēlkama mō saa le mon kēlkama tuqē,

bslGroup.num: kamatōl mē vēsvēsē gengen.

bslGroup.bsl: Be yu3f. i stap holem [hah, totqe, hol] wanem ia?
bslGroup.num: Wat kōmtōl [ve-ssen̄, ve-muduw, ve-raval] saven nen?
bslGroup.drg: Tōlkmi me-[ssān̄, m̄du, rōvāl] o sav sa nen̄?
bslGroup.olr: Kēlkimi te [jējēn̄, roval, rovroval] sa ti?
bslGroup.lkn: To tēlēmu tē [sosän̄, m̄aju, roval] naha to?

bslGroup.bsl: Long basket blong mi long baksaed blong mi ia, i samfela YAM we mi3f. i bin digimaot
bslGroup.num: Ale na-muk get abe tarwuk en, taklē dam kamatōl mi-gil vētē.
bslGroup.drg: Le get namuk sa le gatgōk sa, o radōn dām tōlkma m-gil dēn a le m̄sa.
bslGroup.olr: Le mok gat lē wētgēk ne, jōn jem kēlkama mō gil.
bslGroup.lkn: Le mok gat tawuu on gatwok heg, ōjēn jam tēlēmä in gil jen.

bslGroup.bsl: Redyam l. plesia, ale hemia i waelyam nomo, wetem wovile
bslGroup.num: Dam ve-mme abene, kose wiag am, vaten tomag.
bslGroup.drg: O dām ve-mme sa, seg o wia[g] wor, valrēg o watmag.
bslGroup.olr: Jem ga meme ine, titi ine jem lē woy, valrēē mēn wotamaa.
bslGroup.lkn: Jam ga meme va'an, to heg in jamlē woo, mēn tamag.

bslGroup.bsl: Yu3f. i bin planem l. karen bl.yam?
bslGroup.num: Kōmtōl mē-vēsē ale wetan dam?
bslGroup.drg: Tōlkmi me-vsōg le m̄sa vatgin o dām?
bslGroup.olr: Kēlkimi mō vusēē le tuqē jem?

bslGroup.num: Bek, veta bas ran ni.
Dam ve-mme nen, kamam mē-vēsē.
bslGroup.drg: Dām ve-mme gēn nen̄ kma me-vsōg.
bslGroup.lkn: Jam ga meme, wo, gamä 'n vahōō.

bslGroup.bsl: Be waelyam ia, hem i stap gru nating nomo, i nogat man i bin planem.
bslGroup.num: Wat wiag en, ve-ttō am tan̄ nen, tudun veta vsē mi.
bslGroup.drg: O wiag sa, {t-sōl || t-wot} wor ti le m̄ōs, o tdun so-vsōg tēmē o wiag nen̄.
bslGroup.olr: La jem lē ne, mala woy ti, tujun̄ tē vusēē wōs.
bslGroup.lkn: La jam lē heg, ni 'n {hēl || tēqēl} m̄ahgen woo, jaajun tē vahōō awōh.

bslGroup.bsl: I no tru yam ia, waelwan bl'm nomo!
bslGroup.num: Veta dam dun mi en, kosen ve-ttō am.
bslGroup.drg: O dām tēmē, o wiag wor, t-sōl wor ti a le m̄ōs.
bslGroup.olr: Tē tirii jem wōs, jem men le gawon woy.
bslGroup.lkn: Tē jam wuswē awōh, heg va in tēqēl woo.

bslGroup.num: M-m, na vi-gil.

bslGroup.bsl: Be basket nambatu, hemia bl. fren bl.yu we hem i karem ia?
bslGroup.num: Wat tuar get kos in, kos nam tuar tuan̄ kos ni ve-muduw?
bslGroup.drg: O get s-rō °deki°, idek nami tuan̄ ni me-m̄du...
bslGroup.olr: Titi gat ni-rō, mon tuan̄ ni m-roval jēk?
bslGroup.lkn: To too gat rek, mon tuan̄ ok irek ni ok tē m̄aju to nen̄?

bslGroup.bsl: I gat wanem insaed? Kakae bl. karen tu?
bslGroup.num: O saven allon? Gengen tale wetan mēlē?
bslGroup.drg: O sav allon? O gāngēn va ta le m̄sa mlē, le...?
bslGroup.olr: Sa lolon? Gēngēn men le tuqē mula?
bslGroup.lkn: (In) naha lolon? Gängän avan lē m̄as lēh?

bslGroup.num: Ee, qet en.

bslGroup.bsl: Ating? Be mi ting se taro i no save gru l. eria ia, from i nogat wora?
bslGroup.num: Vi-dun wun? Na ve dōm si qet en manta ttō le ale wasn̄in en, sur bē bek?
bslGroup.drg: Ledun? Na tō-dōm ti kak o qet te sōl late aē nen̄, sur ka o bē obek.
bslGroup.olr: Wogis? La na m-jējēm ka qet tē malaw wōs le wasn̄i ne, suy pē gaiv.
bslGroup.lkn: Wuswē? La na 'n jējēm sa qet ga tēqēl ēsavōh lē wihn̄i heg, tun̄ okle gaiv.

bslGroup.bsl: Si! Be from, mif. i no planem l. karen ia,
bslGroup.num: Bek! Wat sur kamam veta vēsē mi ale wetan en,
bslGroup.drg: Ledun! La sur ikma so-vsōg tēmē le m̄sa nen̄,
bslGroup.olr: Taga! Suy kama tē vusēē wōs tavtenne,
bslGroup.lkn: Ta! On gamä tē vahōō avōh le m̄as heg,

bslGroup.bsl: mif. i gat wan spesel karen-bl-taro narasaed bl. hil.
bslGroup.num: kama namma lētnōk aben tabe vēvēsē qet aben, taval taqin̄in.
bslGroup.drg: tuar wasn̄in aē tval tōw [aōt] namikma o mat aē...
bslGroup.olr: moma tiri tuqē qet lē talvōn tōw.
bslGroup.lkn: moomä too onreg ga wē ēhē talvōn takm̄ē.

bslGroup.bsl: Feswan, mif. i bin planem pikinini bl'm
bslGroup.num: Taqa, kama mē-vēsē sulun.
tē vēsē bas, tov vusuw.
bslGroup.drg: Me-vsōg bas, so tog wor vetm̄e nen̄ lebē.
bslGroup.lkn: Vahōō pah, lak ukäg tun̄ to lolon.

bslGroup.bsl: From i no taro Fiji ia, aelan taro!
bslGroup.num: Sur kosen veta taro Viti mi, kosen u qet ta *min*!
bslGroup.drg: Sur iseg o tar-Vit tēmē, seg o qet tma gēn.
bslGroup.olr: Suy tē taro Viti wōs nan̄, qet tēmēgēj!
bslGroup.lkn: On heg va tē taro Viti avōh, in qet avan mugēj nen̄!

bslGroup.bsl: Sipos i nogat wora, i no save laef.
bslGroup.num: Moto bē bek, manta mur le.
bslGroup.drg: Seg o bē (vit) bek, tē ēs late.
bslGroup.olr: Ōl pē gaiv, ni ga tē ēs wōs.
bslGroup.lkn: Sa 'n tun̄ wōn gaiv, ni a ēs ēsavōh.

bslGroup.bsl: Taem mif. i luk se lif bl'm i gru bigwan finis,
bslGroup.num: Kama vē-kērē dōdōn ve-ttō ve-llav vata,
bslGroup.drg: Kma m-tek o qet me-mlaw tavul, bas kma m-tek dāgin t-sēw ti, ti vamen.
bslGroup.olr: Kamam mō ēl jawi ga rēērēē,
bslGroup.lkn: Gamä 'n 'ätä sa jawi qet nen̄ in rēgrēg kere nok,

bslGroup.num: kama vivut vetē.
Man, dōdōn en sa! Ve-llav sa ve-llav!
bslGroup.drg: Eqōwē! Dāgi qet nen̄! Va-lwo rōw soqsoq!
bslGroup.olr: Ōw! Jawi, a! Ga rēē (ga rēē) mamaavis.
bslGroup.lkn: Au gēē at! Jawjawi nen̄! Ga rēgrēg sa!

bslGroup.bsl: Mo stamba bl'm tu, i tik we i tik!
bslGroup.num: Bas qitgin mēlē, vi-ttum sa vi-ttum!
bslGroup.drg: O wigi nen̄ va-lwo rōw mlē!
bslGroup.olr: Qētēqōtgi mula, ga metlut ga metlut!
bslGroup.lkn: Qitiqitgi lēh, ga matlus sa ga matlus!

bslGroup.bsl: Bae yufala i bekem laplap bl. taro?
bslGroup.num: Kimi te taqes (u) labalam qet?
bslGroup.drg: Kmi so-vror o qet nen̄? Kmi s-taklig o lablab qet ni?
bslGroup.olr: Kimi ga jaw voroy mēn qet?

bslGroup.num: Vi-dun, wun.

bslGroup.bsl: Bekem laplap, sipos no, mekem nalot l'm.
bslGroup.num: Te taqes labalam, suqe bek, te takili { lōt ni || ni lōt }.
bslGroup.drg: Kma so-tqās lablab ni, le kak kma s-taklig o lōt ni.
bslGroup.olr: Walwal voroy, ōl sōw, gis lēp mē.
bslGroup.lkn: Wälwäl varoo, wōn ta, mäkä lap mē.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi mi laekem nalot bitim laplap.
bslGroup.num: Na na ve-mōrōs lōt den u labalam.
bslGroup.drg: Na na va-mrōs o lōt va-wē sāl o lablab.
bslGroup.olr: Na ga mērēs lēp nan̄ jēn voroy.
bslGroup.lkn: Na a marēs siisa lap res jen varoo.

bslGroup.bsl: L. kijin bl. mi mi gat 1 bigwan dish-bl-nalot,
bslGroup.num: Ale kijin namuk, namuk tibi ti-twal ve-llav aben,
bslGroup.drg: {Le gvur namuk || Le gavruk}, tbē va-lwo rōw vatgin o lōt t-tog ti,
bslGroup.olr: Le muk guvuy walwal, muk tēpē ga rēē iē,
bslGroup.lkn: Le mok um̄ä, mok too qatug tapē ēhē,

bslGroup.num: gavit lōt ti-tōl tabe ve-lōt ni lōt,
bslGroup.olr: juwalēp ni-tēl suy ga tēw lēp mē,
bslGroup.lkn: tēgalap ni-tēl avan a gih lap mē,

bslGroup.num: bas ga-tēvtēvē lōt te-vet tabe ve-tev ni lōt.
bslGroup.drg: o masgōt s-vāt vatgin s-tev o lōt ni!
bslGroup.olr: titi matayga ni-vat suy ga tava lēp mē, ga sēl jēn lē tēpē.
bslGroup.lkn: to matētävtävä ni-väs ga tävä in lap mē.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi wan mi katem l. wud!
bslGroup.num: Na magesek am na ve-tsōn̄ abe rega.
bslGroup.drg: Na magsēk wor na me-tsōn̄ ni o rga.
bslGroup.olr: Na woy m̄aasēk na m-tava mēn raga.
bslGroup.lkn: Na m̄ahgek woo 'n tasun̄ mēn rägä!

bslGroup.bsl: I gut. Be hemia we mi mi laekem mo, nalot bl.bredfrut, wetem oel bl.nangae
bslGroup.num: Ve-bon̄. Wat kosen na ve-mōrōs { wos || adan }, lōt bata, vaten bes tabe n̄a.
bslGroup.drg: Va-wē. Na na va-mrōs o lōt vatgin o bta, o bās vatgin o n̄a ve-kōr aē.
bslGroup.olr: Ga wē woy. Nan̄ na na ga mērēs sasa, lēp pee, mē tun̄us n̄a.
bslGroup.lkn: Ga wē. La na a marēs siisa in lap peg, mēn rem avan on an̄ä.

bslGroup.num: Vē-dērēm̄ōt sa vē-dērēm̄ōt!

bslGroup.bsl: Be laswan basket ia? Aelan-kabis ia?
bslGroup.num: Wat kos u get atuwur ek? U sosorov?
bslGroup.drg: La o get vagvagē sa? O trōv sa?
bslGroup.olr: La gat nan̄ vagvagē? Tirō nan̄?
bslGroup.lkn: To gat vagvagē nen̄? Tōrō atmugēj nen̄?

bslGroup.num: E! U get wiskit en?
Bek, kosen tare { vinvin-gengen || ror } am!
bslGroup.drg: Obek, i sa o viror wor!
bslGroup.olr: Gaiv, nan̄ vrojroj ga sa woy!
bslGroup.lkn: Ta gēn! Heg va wēēwēē roo woo!

bslGroup.bsl: Mi3f. i stap go sakemaot i lus l. bush
bslGroup.num: Kamatōl te an ti bē-sēvsēvtē vallen̄ ale vewon.
bslGroup.drg: Tōlkma t-van qāvtē ti a mke qāgqēg.
bslGroup.olr: Kēlkama van me qaa vuta le gawon.
bslGroup.lkn: Tēlēmä tē va, äqä tagee to lē gawon.

bslGroup.bsl: Nogat! Givim l.mi festaem, bae mi karem se blong pig i kakae
bslGroup.num: Tog! Le ma min na titi, na te le tabe wutve te gen.
bslGroup.drg: Tog! Ar te qāgqēg vtē te! La m̄o min na, na s-sol min nablōk o wde s-gān.
bslGroup.olr: Sōw! La m̄o mun na, na ga gis suy qo ga gēn.
bslGroup.lkn: Van wutää! Lä mun na m̄o, na a lä gan gēēwēē pula-k qo a gän.

bslGroup.bsl: Banis bl. mifela i stanap klosap nomo.
bslGroup.num: Gear namma ve-tur ve-rivte am.
bslGroup.drg: Namikma o ar wde a vrigtēg wor!
bslGroup.olr: Muk peret {suy muk qo || men le qo} saa rivtaa woy suy gēj.
bslGroup.lkn: Moomä ar in {tuu || hag} rigtäg woo!

bslGroup.num: Antonet Rovanle (18)

bslGroup.bsl: Trigeta woman i stap staon wantaem l. haos-kuk ia,
bslGroup.num: Ratōl tawa van in te sa tuwal (ti) abe tin wēm,
bslGroup.drg: Ra rqa bul tōl nēr t-tog t' a le-gvur nen̄,

bslGroup.num: rōtōl tē-dēsē ti?
Rōtōl te taqtaqes ti.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol i rerem wan bigfela kakae l. olgeta bl. vilej.
bslGroup.num: Rōtōl ve-salamat tabe ve-da tuar gengen ve-llav na(g)anēr ale sar.
bslGroup.drg: Nēr t-salmat ti sur o gāngēn vi-lwo ganēr o sul ta le-vre sa.

bslGroup.bsl: Yu luk, ol i tekem samfela yam,
bslGroup.num: Kērē, nēr ve-le taklē dam,
bslGroup.drg: Tek mē, nēr m-la ma o radōn dām,

bslGroup.bsl: ale samfela woman i tekemaot skin bl'm,
bslGroup.num: taklē ramel tawa vi-sim vētē vinin,
bslGroup.drg: radōn ra rqa { t-sis || t-sēb } dēn o vnin ti,

bslGroup.num: bas taklēn ve-rese.

bslGroup.bsl: Afta, bae ol i rolemap l. lif laplap?
bslGroup.num: Bas, nir tov snuw ale dove?
bslGroup.drg: Bas, nēr s-verāg o darga ror le tan?

bslGroup.bsl: Yes, bae ol i jas rolemap, fasem wanwan bandel bl'm w. lif nakaria
bslGroup.num: Ee, nir to-qar sunuw, nir ti-vvis tuwtuwal m̄onom̄on vaten dokiri.
bslGroup.drg: E, nēr so-don̄ ror lablab le darga sa, bas nēr so-m̄nag;

bslGroup.bsl: Be noyet: i mas laetem faia festaem.
bslGroup.num: Wat tuqa: ti bilen̄ taqa wev.
bslGroup.drg: la tuqa titi: so-wdōn̄ m̄o o āv.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi luk se olgeta man ol i go katem finis faiawud long bush ol i karem i kam i stap hipap long haos.
bslGroup.num: Na vē-kērē ramel m̄er nir ve-an ata be-tartar rilit ale vewon nir ve-le ata ma vinuvu ti ale guvur.
bslGroup.drg: Na m-tek (ra)dōn tdun m-tar nok ma o lēt ma le m̄ōs nēr m-la nok ma nēr me-mtuwqag {a-gvur || a le-gvur}.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem nao. I mas statem faia festaem dip long hol bl. oven ananit, wetem smosmol wud o string kokonas.
bslGroup.num: Ni nen wa. Gin te gal taqa wev ale mataqen tabe wēm ni tare masmasbe rilit si vin mutu.
bslGroup.drg: Ni gēn { nen̄ || sa }. So-qtēg o āv ror le um gin o brinti lēt le o vni mtō.

bslGroup.bsl: Rabem faia, o olsem wanem? - Olbaot.
bslGroup.num: Te sos wev, si bek? - Ve-bon̄ am.
bslGroup.drg: S-sos o āv, le s-daksa? - Vawē wor.
bslGroup.lkn: Hoh äv, le ga gähä? - Ga wē woo.

bslGroup.bsl: Faia i stat gut finis, yumi hipimap ol ston bl. oven ol i mas hot tumas
bslGroup.num: Wev ve-lawalaw lin̄lin̄i vata, alē gin te le kal sa vat bunbun nir ti-ttun lin̄lin̄i.
bslGroup.drg: O āv va-lwo rōw mlēti, gēn s-vēl o vāt wdōn̄ sur nēr so-mme.

bslGroup.bsl: Ale, faia i [lal], tang bl. faia i godaon lelbit
bslGroup.num: Bas, wev ve-ron̄ot, vi-siw gele,

bslGroup.bsl: yumi tekemaot ol hot ston wetem wud-blong-tekem-ston
bslGroup.num: gin te le gasbalet gin te balet ni vat.
bslGroup.drg: gēn s-la o blāt gēn so-blāt o vāt ve-mme

bslGroup.bsl: Putum kakae o laplap i stap antap,
bslGroup.num: Gin te le ror gengen si labalam te sa ameken,
bslGroup.drg: bas, so la ror gāngēn le kak o lablab ror le um,

bslGroup.num: te wōdōn̄ kēl ni vat.
bslGroup.drg: bas so-blāt kēl o vāt gor.

bslGroup.bsl: Putum rop-bl.-pig [philodendron] mo narafala lif, ale i finis.
bslGroup.num: Turuw ni doadōlōn̄ vaten (tak)taklē dorega, bas tov bas.
bslGroup.drg: Bas, s-tētqēv gin o dalōn̄ valrēg ma dave, bas so bas ē.

bslGroup.bsl: Bae yumi wet nomo se kakae i tan finis,
bslGroup.num: Gin te sa dērē am gengen te monog,
bslGroup.drg: Gēn s-tog rē o tqās so-mnog,

bslGroup.bsl: ale yumi evriwan i openem oven.
bslGroup.num: bas gin tov lik (taqtaqes)

bslGroup.bsl: Samtaem, mi luk olgeta i mekem wan big hol l. kakae ;
bslGroup.num: Taklē qōn̄ na vē-kērē nir ve-takili wēm ve-llav tabe gengen,
bslGroup.drg: Tuar qōn̄ na m-tek nēr me-trin̄ o um vi-lwo rōw vatgin gāngēn.

bslGroup.bsl: Wan woman i tekem solwora ale i stanap antap,
bslGroup.num: tuar tawa vē-tēr naw ni vi-tur kal ameken,
bslGroup.drg: Tuar rqa me-tur o bō naw m-tur a-mken,

bslGroup.num: ni tov don̄ ror le wēm.

bslGroup.bsl: Bigfela smok i kamaot, wan volkenu wantaem ia!
bslGroup.num: Was ve-llav ve-qoq den, tuar { waur || garet } ran wa!
bslGroup.drg: Gasi āv vi-lwo so qoq, m̄rag o (gasi) grāt atwal!

bslGroup.bsl: No, i no smok ia, stim (bl. solwora) nomo.
bslGroup.num: Bek, veta was mi, tuttun { taben || tabe naw } am.
bslGroup.drg: Bek, o gasi āv tēmē, o { sawi o naw || sawin } wor.

bslGroup.bsl: Ol i bekem laplap olsemia taem i gat wan big lafet, olsem wan maret.
bslGroup.num: Nir ve-takili labalam tan̄ nen tan̄-ni sa tuar lavet ve-llav, tan̄-ni tuar legleg.
bslGroup.drg: Nēr t-taklig o gāngēn vi-lwo sa ti sur o talwōn̄ vi-lwo, m̄rag tuar lāglēg.

bslGroup.bsl: Be tedei, kakae bl. olgeta fiu nomo,
bslGroup.num: Wat aqri, gengen na-e ramel tudun ti-vis am,
bslGroup.drg: La aqri, ganēr wor bul vēs o gāngēn sa,

bslGroup.bsl: i no nid bl. mekem i bigwan.
bslGroup.num: veta ser tavul mi tabe ve-da ve-llav.
bslGroup.drg: va-wē tēmē sur s-taklig sur so-lwo.

bslGroup.num: Na ve-milin̄sal ata!
Ken Stiven (34)

bslGroup.bsl: E, tugeta! Yu2f. i wantem folem mi i go [hag] l. bigfela wora/lek?
bslGroup.num: E! Rar m̄er! Kumur ve mōrōs te 'n usur na te van kal { le Tes || le bē ve-llav }?
bslGroup.drg: E! rōrqa! Kmur va-mrōs vanvan srēg na van kal sag a {Bētās || lē-bē vi-lwo} ?
bslGroup.mrl: Sōmrō! Kamrō nu-mërōs *usurō* sa-van { lē-bē lav || le-tes } ?

bslGroup.bsl: I gut! Bae yumi3 i resis i jiam stanap wantaem i godaon l.wora?
bslGroup.num: Ve-bon̄! Dōtōl ti-ginte ti-tur ran tov row le bē?
bslGroup.drg: Va-wē. Tōlgēn so vivrisa ror s-row tur a lē-bē?
bslGroup.mrl: Nu-wea. Gean bul töl se-gisra so-row tur vitwel (sōw) lē-bē?

bslGroup.bsl: Yestedei mif. i bin pleple olsemia kasem tudak!
bslGroup.num: Nanno kama me oror tan̄ nen mi-din̄ ran qōn̄!
bslGroup.drg: Nanno, kma m-oror (qōn̄) vetm̄e seg m-dēn̄ o qōn̄.
bslGroup.mrl: Nanano, kemem m-oror m̄er kē dean̄ nō-qōn̄.

bslGroup.num: Bek, dōtōl te suwsuw lin̄lin̄i am.
bslGroup.mrl: O, tēgē, gean (bul töl) suwsuw mēnmēn gom!

bslGroup.bsl: Spos yumi3 jiam i go(daon) l.wora, bae yumi fraetem ol fish i lus.
bslGroup.num: Sur qe dōtōl te row tēqēl le bē, tare wēg te qane gin nir tov toto.
bslGroup.drg: Vit itōlgēn s-salvut ror lē-bē, gēn s-daw o mās s-toto bas.
bslGroup.mrl: Kan si gean mi row lēbē, gean sa-da mëtëwut re eag ker so-tollen̄.

bslGroup.num: Bas nen? Nir tov qane!

bslGroup.bsl: No, be from swim finis, mi laekem sakem net (l.ol fish)
bslGroup.num: Bek, sur na, suwsuw bas, na ve mōrōs gar vētē nēt.
bslGroup.drg: La sur, gēn so-llos bas, na va-mrōs rev o sar.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē! Suwsuw bas, në n-mërōs barta nēt.

bslGroup.bsl: Bae yu sakem net ia we yu holem? - Yes.
bslGroup.num: Nik te gar vētē nēt en sa nik vē-tēr? - Ve-bon̄.
bslGroup.drg: Nēk s-aqtē o sar nen̄ nēk me-tur? - E!
bslGroup.mrl: Neak sa-barta nē-nēt n̄ea neak nu-tör n̄ea? - Ee!

bslGroup.bsl: Be hol bl.net bl.yu i bigwan tumas, yu mas tekem we hol bl'm i smosmol lelbit.
bslGroup.num: Wat namun̄ mataqe nēt en ve-llav wos, nik te le am sa mataqen wistik gele.
bslGroup.drg: La o qarn̄a sar namon̄ va-lwo soqsoq, nēk s-la sa o qarn̄a in o tiktik tavul.
bslGroup.mrl: Tu no-wwo tabo-mogon̄ nēt nu-llawo soksok, neak sē-lē kele no-wwo tabēn nu-wirwirig.

bslGroup.bsl: Mo yu luk? Net bl.yu i brobrok l.pl.ia, mo l.pl.ia tu.
bslGroup.num: Ma kērē! Namun̄ nēt en ve-mommogor abene, ma abene mēlē.
bslGroup.drg: Nēk m-tek? Namon̄ o sar nen̄ va-momgor aē seg, titi aē nei.
bslGroup.mrl: Tu wo mata! Mōn̄ nēt nu-menmeder kelkē, kelkē.

bslGroup.bsl: Be mi nogat narawan bl'm, hemia nomo mi gat.
bslGroup.num: Wat bek mēlē, ni am ne.
bslGroup.drg: La namuk o tuar sar obek mlē, su-twal gēn wor seg le.
bslGroup.mrl: Tu no tagatea mila, n̄elkan no gom bēn.

bslGroup.bsl: Kas! Be yu tekem spia/masket nomo yu sperem fis l'm.
bslGroup.num: E! wa (kēptē am nēt en), nik te le am wulu nik tov gos ni wēg.
bslGroup.drg: Lavtiti wor o sar, nēk s-la wor o karkar nēk s-tēw o mās ni.
bslGroup.mrl: Wērēs! Tu m̄erē, wo lē mogon̄ rē-gaggag wo gag (n-eag) nea.

bslGroup.bsl: Ee, sore, masket bl.mi i brok, mi nomo save daedaeva l'm.
bslGroup.num: O, magōrōs, namuk wulu ve-malat, na manta gosgos le nin ek.
bslGroup.drg: E matnerov, namuk o karkar me mlat, na vtē tēw late o mās ni.
bslGroup.mrl: Ey, mētēnarop, mugu-k rē-gaggag nu-melet, no bit gërgër le tea nea.

bslGroup.bsl: Sipos no, yumi tekem nomo bambu [têhêl] yumi huk fish l'm. - I gut.
bslGroup.num: Si qe bek, gin te le am qet-reverev gin te rev ni wēg. - Ve-bon̄.
bslGroup.drg: Kak obek, gēn s-la wor o vsigasāl ti gēn sālsēl ni. - Va-wē.
bslGroup.mrl: Si mē-tēgē, dē-lē gom ne-qet-rēprēp dē-van bē-rēprēp eag nea! - Nu-wea.

bslGroup.bsl: Yu traem karem ikam festaem wan huk, wetem string.
bslGroup.num: Le laēs ma tuar ga-qalqal vaten ga-reverev.
bslGroup.drg: Nēk s-la m̄o ma o mtagasāl, valrēg o gasāl.
bslGroup.mrl: M̄erē wo-lē mē lotu nō-gō, labaten ne-gewes.

bslGroup.num: Wat ga-be?

bslGroup.bsl: Bae mi2f. i sakem trap, bl. kasem smol naora bl.wora festaem.
bslGroup.num: Kamar ti-tul ti waga tabe te-le masbe wōr wiskit.
bslGroup.drg: Kmār s-tul m̄o o waga kmār so-qrin̄ o ōr ta lēbē.
bslGroup.mrl: Kamar se barta ne-ge sawa-gor tabō-ōr, sē tör lē nō-ōr wirwirig ta lē-bē.

bslGroup.bsl: Afta, bae yumi3 i fasem l.huk bl.yu, bl. atraktem fis.
bslGroup.num: Bas, dōtōl tov be abe ga-qalqal, tabe wēg tē-kēr mōrōs.
bslGroup.drg: Titi, tōlgēn so-lgōn gin namon̄ o gasāl, sur s-sāl o mās.
bslGroup.mrl: Bas, gean se leag bo-mogon̄ gō, bē-bēbē eag.

bslGroup.bsl: I gut. Be yumi mas lukaot se yumi fasem-strong beit i no save ronwe.
bslGroup.num: Ve-bon̄. Wat gin { tē || mas } kēr-gor gin ti-vvis mamartig ga-be den manta so le.
bslGroup.drg: Va-wē. La gēn s-tekgor gēn so-lgōn marmar so-tawrās ler van.
bslGroup.mrl: Nu-wea. Si gean se mata-gor gean se-leag vērgē nē-bē biti to.

bslGroup.bsl: From anêyêh, mi2f. w. Edga i bin hukum sam fish,
bslGroup.num: Sur nais ek, kamar tak i Edga me rev taklē wēg,
bslGroup.drg: Sur nan̄ēs gēn ne, kmār tōk i Edga m-sāl dōn mās,
bslGroup.mrl: Sur neweas, to-k i Edga mē-rēp slibat eag,

bslGroup.bsl: be fish bl.mi i kakae bet finis i lego huk, ale hem i swim i lus i livim mi!
bslGroup.num: ma namuk wēg me gen bas ga-be ni tov tan̄ke ga-qalqal, ni tov to vallen̄ den na!
bslGroup.drg: Titi namuk o mās m-gān wor gabe dēn ni m-sakra kēl o gasāl, titi ni m-to atwal ni so tger dēn na.
bslGroup.mrl: Tu nu-mugu-k eag me-gen be-muguk bē, kopta nō-gō, ti van suw suwē nënō!

bslGroup.bsl: Êt! Fish ia, yu ting se bae yu kakae, be olsemia yu stap fidim olgeta nomo!
bslGroup.num: E! Wēg e, nik ve-dōm si nik te gen, kos tan̄ nen nik te van̄en am ti nir!
bslGroup.drg: O mās sa, nēk mō-dōm kak nēk s-gān, la tekvatsa nēk to-vn̄ān wor nēr ti.
bslGroup.mrl: Ey, n-eag kan, neak nu-dōm si neak se-gen, neak lop sa-van̄van̄anear gom!
