Nik vi-gil Sintia?
Sē? Sintia ta M̄erlav en?
bslGroup.drg: I sē sa? Saklin vata M̄erlav sa?
bslGroup.mrl: Si kan? Sintia ta M̄erlav kan?

bslGroup.bsl: No, i no hemia, narawan bl'm
bslGroup.num: Bek, veta-kosen mi, tuar sēsē!
bslGroup.drg: Obek, ni tēmē, tuar v-gēsgēs va sa nen̄i!

bslGroup.bsl: Mi stap tokbaot ia, Sintia gel bl. Mores
bslGroup.num: Na ti-vit ti sur e, Sintia nut Mores.
bslGroup.drg: Na t-vit sur i Saklin m̄alm̄al nami Frank ti.
bslGroup.mrl: Na s-luwluw sur Sintia m̄alm̄al mui Morēs.

bslGroup.bsl: Mores we hem i stap wok l. Santo?
bslGroup.num: Mores ko sa ni te wok ti a Santo?
bslGroup.drg: Frank sa nen̄ kak ni to-mumgu t' a Santo?
bslGroup.mrl: Morēs { kal-kan || kele kan} se wokwok Santo?

bslGroup.bsl: We hem i stap salem fish?
bslGroup.num: Ni te salem ti wēg?
bslGroup.drg: … kak nēr t-wōl o mās dēn ni ti?

bslGroup.bsl: Hem nao. Yu luk finis gel bl'm, Sintia ia?
bslGroup.num: Ni nen wa. Nik ve kērē ata nutun, Sintia en?
bslGroup.drg: Ni gēn nen̄ le. Nēk m-tek nok o m̄alm̄al namon, i Saklin sa?
bslGroup.mrl: N̄alkan! Neak mata vita mōn m̄alm̄al, Sintia kan?

bslGroup.num: Bek, na veta kērē mi ni.

bslGroup.bsl: mi no save se Mores i gat wan gel ia.
bslGroup.num: Na (e)ta gil mi si Mores nutun tawa aben.
bslGroup.drg: Na so-vrēgēl tēmē kak Frank i ntōn aē.
bslGroup.mrl: No ti valgear tea si Morēs, mō(gō)n m̄alm̄al bēn.

bslGroup.num: Ey, nik te galgal en!

bslGroup.bsl: Yu bin mitim hem taem yu2f. i yangfala yet, we olgeta long vilej daon i stap lafet.
bslGroup.num: Nik mē kērē wun ni ni m̄alam̄al ti, sa nēr a le vere ror in te lavet ti.
bslGroup.drg: Nēk m-vārwōn ni kmur o m̄alm̄al o lōmgāv mlēti, nēr le vre ror nen̄ t-daw tuar tālwōn̄ ti.
bslGroup.mrl: Neak { mō-vōnē || ma-matanea } kan kamrō m̄alm̄al lōmgev tu, kele kan kear lē verē kos n̄ē se-dada ne-levēt.

bslGroup.num: Nallon̄ vi-sil ata?

bslGroup.bsl: Long taem ia hem i sotfala lelbit, mo hem i stap tanem hea blong hem.
bslGroup.num: A le taem en, ni visbutut gele, ni vivir navlōn.
bslGroup.drg: Le wasn̄in nen̄, ni va-tgin galāg, ni to-wlig na-vlōn ti.
bslGroup.mrl: Lē mësë kan, sean nu-malveti gele, nin kan sean se walwaleg nō-vōlōn.

bslGroup.num: O, na ve dōm wun!

bslGroup.bsl: Be from, l. taem ia mi wan pikinini yet, mi no stap lukluk ol gel!
bslGroup.num: Wat sur ale taem en na m̄am̄m̄ari vaenti, na veta kērkēr ramel m̄alam̄al.
bslGroup.drg: La sur, le wasn̄in nen̄, na o m̄erm̄er mlēti, na s-tektek tēmē m̄alm̄al.
bslGroup.mrl: Sur lē mësë sean, no nō-lōm̄ēr tu, no ti matmata tea re mel m̄alm̄al.

bslGroup.bsl: Mi tingbaot se hem i stap storian gut, hem i laf gut.
bslGroup.num: Na ve dōm wun ni te manmanes lin̄lin̄i, ni ve vatn̄el lin̄lin̄i.
bslGroup.drg: Na me-dōm wōn ni to-vavgat tavul ti, ni t-bor tavul ti.
bslGroup.mrl: No nu-dovoën si kisean su-luwluw mēnmēn, sean sa-manman mēnmēn.

bslGroup.bsl: Yes, long naet ia yutufela i bin tanis kasem delaet,
bslGroup.num: Aa, a le qōn̄ en, kumur me lak din̄ maren,
bslGroup.drg: Rum̄er, le qōn̄ nen̄ kmur m-lak dēn̄ o mrān,
bslGroup.mrl: E, lō-qōn̄ sean, kamrō ma-lak dean̄ ne-meren,

bslGroup.bsl: mi ting se yu stap krangke from hem!
bslGroup.num: na ve dōm si { nik te mōrōs ti ni || nik te da ti sur ni }.
bslGroup.drg: na me-dōm kak nēk t-daw sur ni ti!
bslGroup.mrl: no dōm si neak se-teltel surea!

bslGroup.bsl: Nogat! Mi2f. i tanis gut nomo, mi no stap krangke.
bslGroup.num: Bek! Kamar me laklak lin̄lin̄i am, na veta da mi sur ni!
bslGroup.drg: Obek! I kmār m-lak tavul wor, na s-daw rōrōw tēmē sur ni.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē! Kamar ma-lak mēnmēn gom, no ti teltel tea!

bslGroup.bsl: Mi laekem fasin bl'm, be hem i bunbun tumas.
bslGroup.num: Na ve mōrōs namatvun, wat sur ni ve bala wos.
bslGroup.drg: Na va-mrōs n-matvōn, la sur ni va-bla soqsoq.
bslGroup.mrl: Në n-mërōs na-matvōn, si sean nu-m̄aker soksok.

bslGroup.bsl: O be yu no luk hem?
bslGroup.num: O wat nik veta kērē mi ni?
bslGroup.mrl: Tu neak ti matanea {tea || ti mea}?

bslGroup.num: Ni ve an me lēs a noknok e.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i nomo bunbun nao, hem i kam fatfat gut nao.
bslGroup.num: Ni veta bala mi nek, ni ve-ttum lin̄lin̄i nek.
bslGroup.drg: Dēkēn, ni va-bla nok tēmē, dēkēn ni me-ttum tavul.
bslGroup.mrl: Sean ti m̄aker tea rënea, sean nu-rim mēnmēn rënea.

bslGroup.num: Ni ve-qatsal mēlē?

bslGroup.bsl: Uy! I kam longwan we i longwan,
bslGroup.num: Ow! Ni ve-qatsal sa ve-qatsal,
wun ve-qatsal sel nik.

bslGroup.bsl: Olsemia hem i nomo wan smol gel.
bslGroup.num: Noknok e ni veta tawa wiskit mi.
bslGroup.drg: Dēkēn ni o brinti m̄erm̄er nok tēmē
bslGroup.mrl: M̄arn̄ea sean ti m̄alm̄al wirig tea rënea.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i wan woman finis nao!
bslGroup.num: Ni tuar tawa ve-llav vata nek!
bslGroup.drg: Dēkēn ni o rqa vi-lwo nok!

bslGroup.bsl: Be fasin bl'm i naes stil?
bslGroup.num: Wat na-matvun ve-bon̄ vaenti?

bslGroup.bsl: Yes, hem i stap toktok gut long evriwan,
bslGroup.num: Mm, ni te manmanes lin̄lin̄i ti min ramel tudun dōl,
bslGroup.drg: E, ni to-vavgat tavul min o tdun dōl ti,
bslGroup.mrl: Ee, sean nu-luwluw mēnmēn mē(n) rë tëdun dōl,

bslGroup.bsl: hem i no stap kros olbaot.
bslGroup.num: nallon veta anan kēlkēl.

bslGroup.bsl: Hem i maret finis, o noyet?
bslGroup.num: Ni ve-leg vata, si bek vaenti?
bslGroup.drg: Ni m-lāg nok, le bek mlēti?
bslGroup.mrl: Sean nu-leg vita, tēgē-h tēqē tea?

bslGroup.bsl: Noyet, be hem i gat finis wan boefren,
bslGroup.num: Bek tuqa, wat na-bulsalan aben.
bslGroup.drg: Bek mlēti, la namon nok o bulsal aē.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē-h, nen kisean nu-bulsalan bēn vita.

bslGroup.bsl: Long taem we bae yu luk hem bakegen, boe ia bae hem i blokem hem finis.
bslGroup.num: (An̄is si) nik te kērē kēl ni, m̄erat en vivil (sōm) gor vata ni.
bslGroup.drg: An̄ēs nēk s-tek kēl mlē ni, o lōmgāv sa, m-vēl nok o sōm gor ni.
bslGroup.mrl: Lē mësë kan neak se matanea kēl, nō-lōmgep sean nu-da-goro vita.

bslGroup.num: Ruru, nut-ruru vata aben?

bslGroup.bsl: Noyet, be mi harem se Sintia i gatbel,
bslGroup.num: Bek tuqa, wa na ve ron̄ote si Sintia na-taqan ata aben.
bslGroup.drg: Obek mlēti! La na m-ron̄ kak Saklin na-tqan aē.
bslGroup.mrl: Tēqē tea, nen no nu-rron̄ si Sintia na-taqan bēn.

bslGroup.bsl: long manis okis bae hem i jes karem pikinini
bslGroup.num: ale wisn̄ar Okus ni to qar { le || vusus } nutun.
bslGroup.drg: O sn̄ar vatgin Okus ni qra vsus.
bslGroup.mrl: lē vōl Okus sean qer lē natōn.

bslGroup.bsl: Be boefren bl'm, yu save se hem huia?
bslGroup.num: Wat na-bulsalan, nik vi-gil si sē?
bslGroup.drg: La namon o bulsal, nēk va-vrēgēl kak ni isē?
bslGroup.mrl: Tu i bulsalan, neak nu-valgear si isē?

bslGroup.bsl: Mi save nem bl'm, mi save se hem i bl. wea, mi save evriwan samting l. saed bl'm.
bslGroup.num: Na vi-gil nassin, na vi-gil si ni t-ave, na vi-gil savasav dōl t-aē ni.
bslGroup.drg: Na va-vrēgēl na-ssan, na va-vrēgēl kak ni vat ave, na va-vrēgēl bas gin ni.
bslGroup.mrl: Në n-valgear na-ssan, në n-valgear si sean n-at tavea, në n-valgear sapsap dōl ta mia.

bslGroup.bsl: Êt! From wanem ? Wan fren bl.yu ?
bslGroup.num: E! Sur saven? Tuar bulsal namun̄?
bslGroup.drg: E! Sur sa? Namon̄ o bulsal?

bslGroup.bsl: Nogat! Yu no kasem yet? - Se... ?!
bslGroup.num: Bek! Nik vitis le mi? - Si…?
bslGroup.drg: Obek! Nēk sowse vārdēn̄ te ma ni? - Kak sa?
bslGroup.mrl: Tēgē! Neak ti dalē tēqē tea? - Si na-sa?

bslGroup.bsl: Se boefren bl. Sintia, MI nao!
bslGroup.num: Si bulsal nam Sintia, ina!
bslGroup.drg: Kak nami Saklin bulsal, na gēn sa le!

bslGroup.bsl: Ating?! Be mi no save, yu mas talem festaem!
bslGroup.num: Vi-dun? Wat na veta gil mi! Nik ti-vit lu taqa!
bslGroup.drg: Ledun? Na so-vrēgēl tēmē, nēk vit vit m̄o!
bslGroup.mrl: Surwea? tu no ti valgear tea, neak qer sur am̄o!

bslGroup.num: Na ve-mōrōs namalan̄ te row am den.
bslGroup.mrl: Në n-mërōs da gom si ineak so-gol.

bslGroup.num: Auu, namalak ve row wos den!
Tan̄ nen, namun̄ tawa Sintia?
bslGroup.drg: Daksa, namon̄ o rqa i Saklin?

bslGroup.num: Namuk tawa ni nen wa!
bslGroup.drg: Namuk gēn o rqa nen̄ le!

bslGroup.num: Au! Varean ve-llav wos!

bslGroup.bsl: Mi kongratuletem yu tu-taem: from maret bl.yu, mo from pikinini!
bslGroup.num: Na vi-vit varean vaguru min nik: sur legleg nammur, ma sur nutmur.
bslGroup.drg: Na m-vit varean vag-rō: sur o lāglēg namon̄, sur i ntōn̄!
bslGroup.mrl: Në { nu-vvaravo-k || vvorop gineak} vagarō! Sur nō-mōgōn̄ legleg, nen sur ran natōmrō!
